quotes.quote: Don't cry because it's over, smile because it happened.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, today is a gift of God, which is why we call it the present.
quotes.author: Bil Keane

quotes.quote: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  Lady Windermere's Fan

quotes.quote: Listen to the mustn'ts, child. Listen to the don'ts. Listen to the shouldn'ts, the impossibles, the won'ts. Listen to the never haves, then listen close to me... Anything can happen, child. Anything can be.
quotes.author: Shel Silverstein

quotes.quote: At the moment of death I hope to be surprised.
quotes.author: Ivan Illich

quotes.quote: Hope is the only universal liar who never loses his reputation for veracity.
quotes.author: Robert Green Ingersoll

quotes.quote: Hope is the last thing a person does before they are defeated.
quotes.author: Henry Rollins

quotes.quote: The world is bad but not without hope. It is only hopeless when you look at it from an ideal viewpoint.
quotes.author: Friedrich Durrenmatt

quotes.quote: It's time to get real, folks. Hope and change ain't working. Hope and change is not a solution. Hope and change is not a job.
quotes.author: Herman Cain

quotes.quote: I always believe things are going to work out.
quotes.author: Francoise Sagan

quotes.quote: We often call a certainty a hope, to bring it luck.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Bibesco

quotes.quote: Hope is independent of the apparatus of logic.
quotes.author: Norman Cousins

quotes.quote: Easter is meant to be a symbol of hope, renewal, and new life.
quotes.author: Janine di Giovanni

quotes.quote: Outside of the cross of Jesus Christ, there is no hope in this world. That cross and resurrection at the core of the Gospel is the only hope for humanity. Wherever you go, ask God for wisdom on how to get that Gospel in, even in the toughest situations of life.
quotes.author: Ravi Zacharias

quotes.quote: Infuse your life with action. Don't wait for it to happen. Make it happen. Make your own future. Make your own hope. Make your own love. And whatever your beliefs, honor your creator, not by passively waiting for grace to come down from upon high, but by doing what you can to make grace happen... yourself, right now, right down here on Earth.
quotes.author: Bradley Whitford

quotes.quote: It is difficult to say what is impossible, for the dream of yesterday is the hope of today and the reality of tomorrow.
quotes.author: Robert H. Schuller

quotes.quote: You may say I'm a dreamer, but I'm not the only one. I hope someday you'll join us. And the world will live as one.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: He who has health, has hope; and he who has hope, has everything.
quotes.author: Thomas Carlyle

quotes.quote: All that I am, or hope to be, I owe to my angel mother.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: The great gift of Easter is hope - Christian hope which makes us have that confidence in God, in his ultimate triumph, and in his goodness and love, which nothing can shake.
quotes.author: Basil Hume

quotes.quote: Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. Nothing can be done without hope and confidence.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: Black and white are the colors of photography. To me they symbolize the alternatives of hope and despair to which mankind is forever subjected.
quotes.author: Robert Frank

quotes.quote: A good teacher can inspire hope, ignite the imagination, and instill a love of learning.
quotes.author: Brad Henry

quotes.quote: There was never a night or a problem that could defeat sunrise or hope.
quotes.author: Bernard Williams

quotes.quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
quotes.author: Robert Fulghum

quotes.quote: You are not here merely to make a living. You are here in order to enable the world to live more amply, with greater vision, with a finer spirit of hope and achievement. You are here to enrich the world, and you impoverish yourself if you forget the errand.
quotes.author: Woodrow Wilson

quotes.quote: Forgiving does not erase the bitter past. A healed memory is not a deleted memory. Instead, forgiving what we cannot forget creates a new way to remember. We change the memory of our past into a hope for our future.
quotes.author: Lewis B. Smedes

quotes.quote: Frustration, although quite painful at times, is a very positive and essential part of success.
quotes.author: Bo Bennett

quotes.quote: Where there is no vision, there is no hope.
quotes.author: George Washington Carver

quotes.quote: A leader is a dealer in hope.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.quote: Imagine all the people living life in peace. You may say I'm a dreamer, but I'm not the only one. I hope someday you'll join us, and the world will be as one.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: Pakistan not only means freedom and independence but the Muslim Ideology which has to be preserved, which has come to us as a precious gift and treasure and which, we hope other will share with us.
quotes.author: Muhammad Ali Jinnah

quotes.quote: I hope everyone that is reading this is having a really good day. And if you are not, just know that in every new minute that passes you have an opportunity to change that.
quotes.author: Gillian Anderson

quotes.quote: But what we call our despair is often only the painful eagerness of unfed hope.
quotes.author: George Eliot

quotes.quote: Hope is the feeling we have that the feeling we have is not permanent.
quotes.author: Mignon McLaughlin

quotes.quote: The future is not Big Government. Self-serving politicians. Powerful bureaucrats. This has been tried, tested throughout history. The result has always been disaster. President Obama, your agenda is not new. It's not change, and it's not hope.
quotes.author: Rush Limbaugh

quotes.quote: I think in my case, I had no choice but to have a good sense of humor. I grew up with my dad, Danny Thomas, and George Burns and Bob Hope and Milton Berle and Sid Caesar and all those guys were at our house all the time and telling jokes and making each other laugh.
quotes.author: Marlo Thomas

quotes.quote: We would not be interested in human beings if we did not have the hope of someday meeting someone worse off than ourselves.
quotes.author: Emile M. Cioran

quotes.quote: I hope people start to look at their lives as the most powerful, creative act they will ever offer this world.
quotes.author: Tom Shadyac

quotes.quote: She gave up beauty in her tender youth, gave all her hope and joy and pleasant ways; she covered up her eyes lest they should gaze on vanity, and chose the bitter truth.
quotes.author: Christina Rossetti

quotes.quote: A lot of people, to attack an outspoken atheist, one of the things they'll do is say, 'You are as bad as the fundamentalist Christians.' And my answer is always, 'I hope so.'
quotes.author: Penn Jillette

quotes.quote: You want to play another kind of character in another genre, and it's been something I've been trying to do if I can in the career so far, and it's something I hope to continue because it's interesting to me and you get to do different things as an actor.
quotes.author: Keanu Reeves

quotes.quote: Very much, string theory is simply a work in progress. What we are inching toward every day are predictions that within the realm of current technology we hope to test. It's not like we're working on a theory that is permanently beyond experiment. That would be philosophy.
quotes.author: Brian Greene

quotes.quote: I'm involved in quite a few ministries as a bridge builder, trying to match generous givers and donors to other ministries. Based on my past, I'm also involved in mainly the prison ministry. I go to jails and prisons and share my story, trying to give them some hope.
quotes.author: Lex Luger

quotes.quote: I have learned from my experiences in this industry that there is absolutely no way to control people's opinions on your performance in your movie. You go out there, promote your film and hope people like the work you did.
quotes.author: Leonardo DiCaprio

quotes.quote: I'm quite a confident person in many ways, but there's only so much you can hear about being compared to Hattie Jacques. For the record, she was a comedy goddess, but she was 25 stone. I hope I'm right in saying I'm not in any way nearly 25 stone.
quotes.author: Miranda Hart

quotes.quote: Sixty-four thousand dollars for a question, I hope they are asking you the meaning of life.
quotes.author: Paul Scofield

quotes.quote: I try to make a dent in people when I can. I figure people drift toward liberalism at a young age, and I always hope that they change when they see how the world really is.
quotes.author: Johnny Ramone

quotes.quote: I hope I can help guys come out and say, 'All right, dude, I got a manicure... and I liked it.'
quotes.author: Ryan Seacrest

quotes.quote: Helplessness induces hopelessness, and history attests that loss of hope and not loss of lives is what decides the issue of war.
quotes.author: B. H. Liddell Hart

quotes.quote: I hope that 'Jaws' will have brought sharks into the public interest at a time when we desperately need to reevaluate our care for the environment.
quotes.author: Peter Benchley

quotes.quote: I feel blessed to be here representing our country and carrying out th research of scientists around the world... I hope you could feel the positive energy that beamed to the whole planet as we glided over.
quotes.author: Laurel Clark

quotes.quote: I would hope to get together with the Latino community, if I could ever have them talk to me without screaming and threatening me. So I hope to get together with the community and try to explain what we do, so that's going to be one of my missions coming up.
quotes.author: Joe Arpaio

quotes.quote: I wouldn't wear turtlenecks. That I'm not envious of. But who knows? I might sneak out a few things and hope and pray that no one says, 'Hey, didn't you wear that when you were playing an enormous geek on TV?'
quotes.author: Simon Helberg

quotes.quote: Thus we hope to teach mythology not as a study, but as a relaxation from study; to give our work the charm of a story-book, yet by means of it to impart a knowledge of an important branch of education.
quotes.author: Thomas Bulfinch

quotes.quote: I'm always nervous! Especially when it comes to a series like 'Disgaea', where you do have such a devoted fan base, the last thing you want to do is disappoint. But I love playing bad guys and just always hope that fans will be forgiving if I miss the mark.
quotes.author: Troy Baker

quotes.quote: Love recognizes no barriers. It jumps hurdles, leaps fences, penetrates walls to arrive at its destination full of hope.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: I don't think just scaring people is enough. That worked during the freeze days to a major extent, but we really didn't achieve that much even at that time. You have to have more, you have to give people hope and a vision of a better world.
quotes.author: Alan Cranston

quotes.quote: I always like to look on the optimistic side of life, but I am realistic enough to know that life is a complex matter.
quotes.author: Walt Disney

quotes.quote: Hope is the most exciting thing in life, and if you honestly believe that love is out there, it will come. And even if it doesn't come straight away, there is still that chance all through your life that it will.
quotes.author: Josh Hartnett

quotes.quote: I hope my daughter knows that in our house we can make messes and have fun and we'll laugh through it. Granted I don't want her to trash the house, but we do make a lot of messes.
quotes.author: Angela Kinsey

quotes.quote: One of the things I noticed is that people really change when they realize their expiration date is coming, and they know what it is. Most of us don't: we just hope we can live as long as we can and do as much good as we can.
quotes.author: Justin Baldoni

quotes.quote: My politics of optimism and hope still casts its lot with the Democrats - in the optimistic hope that the dying embers of its status as the party of our better angels, one that took risks for social justice, can still be fanned into a flame. But I'm an old man, born in 1969.
quotes.author: Rick Perlstein

quotes.quote: I spread the message of hope and of unity. That's what gets me up in the morning. I can tell you what is wrong, but I can't tell you how to fix it. I'm a raptivist, not a politician. I deal in hope.
quotes.author: Chuck D

quotes.quote: You don't seem to realize that a poor person who is unhappy is in a better position than a rich person who is unhappy. Because the poor person has hope. He thinks money would help.
quotes.author: Jean Kerr

quotes.quote: There is something uniquely depressing about the fact that the National Portrait Gallery's version of the Barack Obama 'Hope' poster previously belonged to a pair of lobbyists. Depressing because Mr. Obama's Washington was not supposed to be the lobbyists' Washington, the place we learned to despise during the last administration.
quotes.author: Thomas Frank

quotes.quote: I don't believe in having one partner for your whole life, but I hope I get married. I want to have a husband and two kids and a nice little life baking pies. I'm quite romantic. It's definitely important to have someone make you feel special.
quotes.author: Hilary Duff

quotes.quote: I don't believe that I'm better than anybody, but I do believe that I'll try harder than most and I hope that people just join me for a little bit of a ride.
quotes.author: Tom DeLonge

quotes.quote: Three grand essentials to happiness in this life are something to do, something to love, and something to hope for.
quotes.author: Joseph Addison

quotes.quote: I think I've always been somebody, since the deaths of my father and brother, who was afraid to hope. So, I was more prepared for failure and for rejection than for success.
quotes.author: Amy Tan

quotes.quote: We go through the whole season working on next season's car and developing the car and making sure we fit in the car and all that sort of stuff. And we obviously give ideas of what we would hope next year's car would have even if it's small things like buttons on the steering wheel and different positions and whatever.
quotes.author: Jenson Button

quotes.quote: I'm a vegetarian and very much active in regards to how I feel about animal rights and protecting animals and giving animals a voice. But at the same time, I appreciate and respect other people's decisions to eat meat. The only thing that I hope is that people are educated, that they're aware, that they're living a conscious lifestyle.
quotes.author: Abbie Cornish

quotes.quote: I try and tell all the kids that I meet that hope to be amazing one day and be a professional athlete or a doctor or a lawyer or whatever they want to be. I tell them they can do all that because Tourette's won't stop them.
quotes.author: Tim Howard

quotes.quote: When one is giving service for the advancement of humanity, when one is working without money and without price, with no hope of earthly reward, there comes a real, genuine joy into the human heart.
quotes.author: Heber J. Grant

quotes.quote: There is a lot of luck in football. Following England is like following Wycombe Wanders or Leyton Orient. You hope for the best and hope you are lucky.
quotes.author: Alan Sugar

quotes.quote: We are laying the foundations of a government, which we hope may outlast the Pyramids.
quotes.author: Caleb Cushing

quotes.quote: I would like to live a day in the life of an ant and hope not to get squashed.
quotes.author: Kiowa Gordon

quotes.quote: I hope people will say, 'Mr. Valentino, he did something for fashion, no?'
quotes.author: Valentino Garavani

quotes.quote: During my life I have seen, known, and lost too much to be the prey of vain dread; and, as for the hope of immortality, I am as weary of that as I am of gods and kings. For my own sake only I write this; and herein I differ from all other writers, past and to come.
quotes.author: Mika Waltari

quotes.quote: My great hope would be that Quebec would realize itself fully as a distinct part of Canada, and stay Canadian, bringing to Canada a part of its richness.
quotes.author: Gabrielle Roy

quotes.quote: Death, only, renders hope futile.
quotes.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs

quotes.quote: We hope we are moving toward a world where sexual orientation is not an issue, because we hate the idea of a gay ghetto. I think that it's a real shame that people become restricted by their sexuality or define their whole lives by their sexuality.
quotes.author: Neil Tennant

quotes.quote: I hope I may have succeeded in presenting to you, however imperfectly, the currents of thought due to the work of the immortal Darwin which have helped to make anthropology what it is at the present time.
quotes.author: Franz Boas

quotes.quote: We hope that eventually there would be an occasion which I can personally prove that game music can in fact impress many different people and move them.
quotes.author: Nobuo Uematsu

quotes.quote: I'm proud of my background, so I hope there will be more roles where Hispanics are being portrayed.
quotes.author: Mario Lopez

quotes.quote: I collaborated with fellow cat lover and designer Geren Ford to create a sweater that we hope any cat parent would wear to show their kitty pride and that all animal lovers can wear in support of the ASPCA.
quotes.author: Kellie Pickler

quotes.quote: To not have any hope is where things start to get really bleak. Things are possible. The impossible can be possible.
quotes.author: Sarah Paulson

quotes.quote: I hope to God that the inner strength that will vindicate my deeds will in good time spring forth from my own people. I have done as I had to on the prompting of my inner voice.
quotes.author: Kurt Huber

quotes.quote: Hope is such a bait, it covers any hook.
quotes.author: Oliver Goldsmith

quotes.quote: All human wisdom is summed up in two words; wait and hope.
quotes.author: Alexandre Dumas

quotes.quote: Hope is not the conviction that something will turn out well but the certainty that something makes sense, regardless of how it turns out.
quotes.author: Vaclav Havel

quotes.quote: Expecting something for nothing is the most popular form of hope.
quotes.author: Arnold H. Glasow

quotes.quote: It is only hope which is real, and reality is a bitterness and a deceit.
quotes.author: William Makepeace Thackeray

quotes.quote: Chance has never yet satisfied the hope of a suffering people.
quotes.author: Marcus Garvey

quotes.quote: Little progress can be made by merely attempting to repress what is evil. Our great hope lies in developing what is good.
quotes.author: Calvin Coolidge

quotes.quote: The trouble with most people is that they think with their hopes or fears or wishes rather than with their minds.
quotes.author: Will Durant

quotes.quote: Beware how you take away hope from another human being.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, Jr.

quotes.quote: Hope springs eternal in the human breast: Man never is, but always to be blest.
quotes.author: Alexander Pope

quotes.quote: The work goes on, the cause endures, the hope still lives and the dreams shall never die.
quotes.author: Edward Kennedy

quotes.quote: When I was young, my ambition was to be one of the people who made a difference in this world. My hope is to leave the world a little better for having been there.
quotes.author: Jim Henson

quotes.quote: Never deprive someone of hope; it might be all they have.
quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quotes.quote: Hope is the word which God has written on the brow of every man.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.quote: Hope is a risk that must be run.
quotes.author: Georges Bernanos

quotes.quote: Hope is the only bee that makes honey without flowers.
quotes.author: Robert Green Ingersoll

quotes.quote: Hope is a good breakfast, but it is a bad supper.
quotes.author: Francis Bacon

quotes.quote: All hope abandon, ye who enter here!
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri

quotes.quote: Hope is tomorrow's veneer over today's disappointment.
quotes.author: Evan Esar

quotes.quote: Man needs, for his happiness, not only the enjoyment of this or that, but hope and enterprise and change.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Hope is a talent like any other.
quotes.author: Storm Jameson

quotes.quote: My great hope is to laugh as much as I cry; to get my work done and try to love somebody and have the courage to accept the love in return.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: What gives me the most hope every day is God's grace; knowing that his grace is going to give me the strength for whatever I face, knowing that nothing is a surprise to God.
quotes.author: Rick Warren

quotes.quote: Hope is patience with the lamp lit.
quotes.author: Tertullian

quotes.quote: Hope in reality is the worst of all evils because it prolongs the torments of man.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow. The important thing is not to stop questioning.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Hope is being able to see that there is light despite all of the darkness.
quotes.author: Desmond Tutu

quotes.quote: We must accept finite disappointment, but never lose infinite hope.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: Hope is like the sun, which, as we journey toward it, casts the shadow of our burden behind us.
quotes.author: Samuel Smiles

quotes.quote: We have always held to the hope, the belief, the conviction that there is a better life, a better world, beyond the horizon.
quotes.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quotes.quote: You may not always have a comfortable life and you will not always be able to solve all of the world's problems at once but don't ever underestimate the importance you can have because history has shown us that courage can be contagious and hope can take on a life of its own.
quotes.author: Michelle Obama

quotes.quote: The human heart has hidden treasures, In secret kept, in silence sealed; The thoughts, the hopes, the dreams, the pleasures, Whose charms were broken if revealed.
quotes.author: Charlotte Bronte

quotes.quote: A little more persistence, a little more effort, and what seemed hopeless failure may turn to glorious success.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: Hope lies in dreams, in imagination, and in the courage of those who dare to make dreams into reality.
quotes.author: Jonas Salk

quotes.quote: Let your hopes, not your hurts, shape your future.
quotes.author: Robert H. Schuller

quotes.quote: I simply can't build my hopes on a foundation of confusion, misery and death... I think... peace and tranquillity will return again.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul - and sings the tunes without the words - and never stops at all.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.quote: Hope will never be silent.
quotes.author: Harvey Milk

quotes.quote: We must free ourselves of the hope that the sea will ever rest. We must learn to sail in high winds.
quotes.author: Aristotle Onassis

quotes.quote: I find hope in the darkest of days, and focus in the brightest. I do not judge the universe.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.quote: You can make positive deposits in your own economy every day by reading and listening to powerful, positive, life-changing content and by associating with encouraging and hope-building people.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: Hope is important because it can make the present moment less difficult to bear. If we believe that tomorrow will be better, we can bear a hardship today.
quotes.author: Thich Nhat Hanh

quotes.quote: We must rediscover the distinction between hope and expectation.
quotes.author: Ivan Illich

quotes.quote: I am prepared for the worst, but hope for the best.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: Courage is like love; it must have hope for nourishment.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.quote: Youth is easily deceived because it is quick to hope.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Hope is definitely not the same thing as optimism. It is not the conviction that something will turn out well, but the certainty that something makes sense, regardless of how it turns out.
quotes.author: Vaclav Havel

quotes.quote: I said to my soul, be still, and wait without hope, For hope would be hope for the wrong thing.
quotes.author: T. S. Eliot

quotes.quote: The hope of a secure and livable world lies with disciplined nonconformists who are dedicated to justice, peace and brotherhood.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: Hope is the pillar that holds up the world. Hope is the dream of a waking man.
quotes.author: Pliny the Elder

quotes.quote: When I stand before God at the end of my life, I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left, and could say, 'I used everything you gave me'.
quotes.author: Erma Bombeck

quotes.quote: When we meet real tragedy in life, we can react in two ways - either by losing hope and falling into self-destructive habits, or by using the challenge to find our inner strength. Thanks to the teachings of Buddha, I have been able to take this second way.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.quote: I hope to live all my life for my art, without abandoning my principles one iota.
quotes.author: Gustave Courbet

quotes.quote: I'm here to spread a message of hope. Follow your heart. Don't follow what you've been told you're supposed to do.
quotes.author: J. Cole

quotes.quote: My dream is of a place and a time where America will once again be seen as the last best hope of earth.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: I hope I shall possess firmness and virtue enough to maintain what I consider the most enviable of all titles, the character of an honest man.
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.quote: There are only two lasting bequests we can hope to give our children. One of these is roots, the other, wings.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: To love means loving the unlovable. To forgive means pardoning the unpardonable. Faith means believing the unbelievable. Hope means hoping when everything seems hopeless.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: I prefer to win titles with the team ahead of individual awards or scoring more goals than anyone else. I'm more worried about being a good person than being the best football player in the world. When all this is over, what are you left with? When I retire, I hope I am remembered for being a decent guy.
quotes.author: Lionel Messi

quotes.quote: Make big plans; aim high in hope and work, remembering that a noble, logical diagram once recorded will not die, but long after we are gone be a living thing, asserting itself with ever-growing insistence.
quotes.author: Daniel Burnham

quotes.quote: Keep all special thoughts and memories for lifetimes to come. Share these keepsakes with others to inspire hope and build from the past, which can bridge to the future.
quotes.author: Mattie Stepanek

quotes.quote: Disappointment is a sort of bankruptcy - the bankruptcy of a soul that expends too much in hope and expectation.
quotes.author: Eric Hoffer

quotes.quote: All the great things are simple, and many can be expressed in a single word: freedom, justice, honor, duty, mercy, hope.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.quote: I hope that in this year to come, you make mistakes. Because if you are making mistakes, then you are making new things, trying new things, learning, living, pushing yourself, changing yourself, changing your world. You're doing things you've never done before, and more importantly, you're doing something.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman

quotes.quote: There is hope for the future because God has a sense of humor and we are funny to God.
quotes.author: Bill Cosby

quotes.quote: Our worldly successes cannot be guaranteed, but our ability to achieve spiritual success is entirely up to us, thanks to the grace of God. The best advice I know is to give is to give those worldly things your best but never your all - reserve the ultimate hope for the only one who can grant it.
quotes.author: Mitt Romney

quotes.quote: We talk a lot about hope, helping, and teamwork. Our whole message is that we are more powerful together.
quotes.author: Victoria Osteen

quotes.quote: There are people who are able to plan their career, their future, but I've never had any talent for that. I just do things and hope for the best. Say yes, take a chance, and sometimes it's terrific and sometimes it's not.
quotes.author: Christopher Walken

quotes.quote: I would hope it's better, but I'm actually acknowledging now that I want to explore all these levels from a whisper to a scream with this gift I've been given.
quotes.author: David Coverdale

quotes.quote: I would love to close my eyes and see myself with my girlfriend when we're 99 years old and I have a pipe and she's knitting a sweater, and I hope that's the way it goes. I think it's a challenge every day.
quotes.author: Chris Messina

quotes.quote: In the long term we can hope that religion will change the nature of man and reduce conflict. But history is not encouraging in this respect. The bloodiest wars in history have been religious wars.
quotes.author: Richard M. Nixon

quotes.quote: Architecture is basically a container of something. I hope they will enjoy not so much the teacup, but the tea.
quotes.author: Yoshio Taniguchi

quotes.quote: The charm of fishing is that it is the pursuit of what is elusive but attainable, a perpetual series of occasions for hope.
quotes.author: John Buchan

quotes.quote: I grew up in Cuba under a strong, military, oppressive dictatorship. So as a teenager, I found myself involved in a revolution. I remember during that time, a young, charismatic leader rose up, talking about hope and change. His name was Fidel Castro.
quotes.author: Rafael Cruz

quotes.quote: Desire is the starting point of all achievement, not a hope, not a wish, but a keen pulsating desire which transcends everything.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: It is my goal to love everyone. I hate no one. Regardless of their race, religion, their proclivities, the desire of their heart and how they want to live their life and the decisions that they make. I can even respect people's decisions and lifestyle choices just as I hope they have the courtesy to respect my decisions and my choices.
quotes.author: Kirk Cameron

quotes.quote: Hope is a very thin diet.
quotes.author: Thomas Shadwell

quotes.quote: Choosing to be positive and having a grateful attitude is going to determine how you're going to live your life.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: In the end, I hope there's a little note somewhere that says I designed a good computer.
quotes.author: Steve Wozniak

quotes.quote: We wrote verses that condemned us, with no hope of pardon, to the most bitter solitude.
quotes.author: Salvatore Quasimodo

quotes.quote: And this we should believe: that hope and volition can bring us closer to our ultimate goal: justice for all, injustice for no-one.
quotes.author: Eyvind Johnson

quotes.quote: The worst enemy of human hope is not brute facts, but men of brains who will not face them.
quotes.author: Max Eastman

quotes.quote: When you're doing an out-and-out comedy, the notion of preparing for a character - I hope I don't reveal too much of myself here - but, uh, no, I'm not doing anything.
quotes.author: Will Ferrell

quotes.quote: The atheist has no hope.
quotes.author: James Freeman Clarke

quotes.quote: I hope to stay unemployed as a war photographer till the end of my life.
quotes.author: Robert Capa

quotes.quote: One of my defining beliefs is that Jesus Christ has taken all of my guilt before God, and that he has been raised from the dead. That gives incredible hope and meaning to every day of my life - that nothing done in this world is wasted when it's done for him and his glory, and that there will be a day of justice and reward for the entire world.
quotes.author: Joshua Harris

quotes.quote: One day I hope to open my own day-care center. My passion for kids is through the roof.
quotes.author: Cam Newton

quotes.quote: I hope that people learn from my mistake and I hope that the fans forgive me.
quotes.author: Rafael Palmeiro

quotes.quote: I've always competed in those shows. Like, I won 'Fear Factor', I did 'I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here', I did 'The Mole', 'Celebrity Apprentice' with Donald Trump. I've done a lot of those shows, all in the hope of being a blessing to my mom's organization.
quotes.author: Stephen Baldwin

quotes.quote: Albert Camus, a great humanist and existentialist voice, pointed out that to commit to a just cause with no hope of success is absurd. But then, he also noted that not committing to a just cause is equally absurd. But only one choice offers the possibility for dignity. And dignity matters. Dignity matters.
quotes.author: David Simon

quotes.quote: I do a lot of inspirational talks for kids, to motivate them to change their lives and give them hope.
quotes.author: Adam Beach

quotes.quote: My mother told me, 'Son, nobody else but God knows.' And that's what I'm about - reaching out to the people, crying with them, giving them hope. Visiting the hospital, visiting the kids with cancer, visiting the adults, and stuff like that. That's what I do.
quotes.author: Mr. T

quotes.quote: I really subscribe to that old adage that you should never let the audience get ahead of you for a second. So if the film's abrasive and wrongfoots people then, y'know, that's great. But I hope it involves an audience.
quotes.author: Paul Thomas Anderson

quotes.quote: Love is a springtime plant that perfumes everything with its hope, even the ruins to which it clings.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert

quotes.quote: They look quite promising in the shop; and not entirely without hope when I get them back into my wardrobe. But then, when I put them on they tend to deteriorate with a very strange rapidity and one feels so sorry for them.
quotes.author: Joyce Grenfell

quotes.quote: With the sugar market hysteria, the people are obviously worried and expect higher inflation. When this hysteria subsides, which we're probably observing, then I hope that people will also get less worried about the future of inflation.
quotes.author: Marek Belka

quotes.quote: I hope girls read what I say in interviews - they should just be themselves.
quotes.author: Taylor Momsen

quotes.quote: Hope makes people good, a lot of the time. You hope for a brighter future, and resentment is outweighed.
quotes.author: Daisy Ridley

quotes.quote: 'Halal in the Family' will expose a broad audience to some of the realities of being Muslim in America. By using satire, we will encourage people to reconsider their assumptions about Muslims, while providing a balm to those experiencing anti-Muslim bias. I also hope those Uncles and Aunties out there will crack a smile!
quotes.author: Aasif Mandvi

quotes.quote: There is in every child at every stage a new miracle of vigorous unfolding, which constitutes a new hope and a new responsibility for all.
quotes.author: Erik Erikson

quotes.quote: Hope begins in the dark, the stubborn hope that if you just show up and try to do the right thing, the dawn will come. You wait and watch and work: you don't give up.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: It would be fun to do a reunion show. I hope we do it some day, but it better be soon. We're all getting on.
quotes.author: William Christopher

quotes.quote: On what rests the hope of the republic? One country, one language, one flag!
quotes.author: Alexander Henry

quotes.quote: Posterity! You will never know how much it cost the present generation to preserve your freedom! I hope you will make a good use of it.
quotes.author: John Adams

quotes.quote: Where I am today... I still have my ups and downs, but I take it one day at a time and I just hope that I can be the best that I can possibly be, not only for myself, but also young people that are out there today that need someone to look up to.
quotes.author: Demi Lovato

quotes.quote: Hope is the only good that is common to all men; those who have nothing else possess hope still.
quotes.author: Thales

quotes.quote: Over the years I've learned how to lock myself up in a prison of hope, knowing that God has nothing but His best planned for me. He promised me things concerning my ministry and my life.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: It is in the admission of ignorance and the admission of uncertainty that there is a hope for the continuous motion of human beings in some direction that doesn't get confined, permanently blocked, as it has so many times before in various periods in the history of man.
quotes.author: Richard P. Feynman

quotes.quote: If it is nothingness that awaits us, let us make an injustice of it; let us fight against destiny, even though without hope of victory.
quotes.author: Miguel de Unamuno

quotes.quote: I'm still like a butterfly going from one job to another job. But it's quite lovely - I hope to keep this freedom, to have fun.
quotes.author: Carine Roitfeld

quotes.quote: Hope and purpose in this world is living as best as you can and maybe having life that gives back. But simply giving back isn't purpose; it's a branch of purpose, but it is not the trunk or root of the tree.
quotes.author: Nick Vujicic

quotes.quote: I hope for the day when everyone can speak again of God without embarrassment.
quotes.author: Paul Tillich

quotes.quote: I'm hopeful. I know there is a lot of ambition in Washington, obviously. But I hope the ambitious realize that they are more likely to succeed with success as opposed to failure.
quotes.author: George W. Bush

quotes.quote: I did nothing to deserve God's love; in fact, I was living as an orphan, without hope. Yet God chose to pursue a relationship with me, and through the death of his son Jesus, I was adopted into God's family.
quotes.author: Steven Curtis Chapman

quotes.quote: It is true that power corrupts. The hope at the polling stations and the actions of the elected representatives, unfortunately, often turn to be opposite. The power of ballot turns into the power of wallet. Some law-makers become law-breakers.
quotes.author: Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj

quotes.quote: A very small degree of hope is sufficient to cause the birth of love.
quotes.author: Stendhal

quotes.quote: I hope the fans have enjoyed listening as much as I've enjoyed doing the games. I don't ever go to the park where I don't have a good day. I don't like losing. But I don't think I ever go to the park where I have a bad day. I don't think once.
quotes.author: Bob Uecker

quotes.quote: The point about hope is that it is something that occurs in very dark moments. It is like a flame in the darkness; it isn't like a confidence and a promise.
quotes.author: John Berger

quotes.quote: It is only by not paying one's bills that one can hope to live in the memory of the commercial classes.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: People are basically the same the world over. Everybody wants the same things - to be happy, to be healthy, to be at least reasonably prosperous, and to be secure. They want friends, peace of mind, good family relationships, and hope that tomorrow is going to be even better than today.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: I would describe myself as emotional and highly strung. If something upsets me, it really upsets me. If something makes me angry, I get really angry. But it's all very upfront. I can't hide it. I'm also loyal and I hope I'm fun.
quotes.author: Nicole Kidman

quotes.quote: How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world.
quotes.author: Anne Frank,  Anne Frank's Tales from the Secret Annex

quotes.quote: Love, hope, fear, faith - these make humanity; These are its sign and note and character.
quotes.author: Robert Browning

quotes.quote: The most insignificant people are the most apt to sneer at others. They are safe from reprisals. And have no hope of rising in their own self esteem but by lowering their neighbors.
quotes.author: William Hazlitt

quotes.quote: The Worldly Hope men set their Hearts upon Turns Ashes - or it prospers; and anon, Like Snow upon the Desert's dusty Face, Lighting a little hour or two - is gone.
quotes.author: Omar Khayyam

quotes.quote: I love my daddy. My daddy's everything. I hope I can find a man that will treat me as good as my dad.
quotes.author: Lady Gaga

quotes.quote: An athlete cannot run with money in his pockets. He must run with hope in his heart and dreams in his head.
quotes.author: Emil Zatopek

quotes.quote: On every birthday, I ask my wife, 'What would you like this year?' and her instant reply is, 'Diamonds! Diamonds! Diamonds!' I'm always living in hope that one day she'll say she just wants me!
quotes.author: Akshay Kumar

quotes.quote: I hope climate science becomes the big thing. And then what I want is electrical engineers to solve the world's energy problems, energy distribution problems. I want mechanical engineers to make better transportation systems. I want chemical engineers to develop better solar panels, and so on.
quotes.author: Bill Nye

quotes.quote: I've had such a satisfying life professionally and personally. I hope my tombstone says, 'Never boring.'
quotes.author: Alan Dershowitz

quotes.quote: A dream is the bearer of a new possibility, the enlarged horizon, the great hope.
quotes.author: Howard Thurman

quotes.quote: The message of Jesus is summed up partly in the Sermon on the Mount, and partly when he begins his ministry and quotes the passage from Isaiah: 'I have come to set free the prisoners and restore sight to the blind.' And certainly, his mission is also to bring hope. It was to heal people, to befriend the outcast.
quotes.author: Dan Wakefield

quotes.quote: The Opera was a very cold film, a hopeless and dark film, no hope, no love.
quotes.author: Dario Argento

quotes.quote: When you run a part of the relay and pass on the baton, there is no sense of unfinished business in your mind. There is just the sense of having done your part to the best of your ability. That is it. The hope is to pass on the baton to somebody who will run faster and run a better marathon.
quotes.author: N. R. Narayana Murthy

quotes.quote: It has never been, and never will be easy work! But the road that is built in hope is more pleasant to the traveler than the road built in despair, even though they both lead to the same destination.
quotes.author: Marion Zimmer Bradley

quotes.quote: Iranian filmmakers are not passive. They fight whenever they can, as creative expression means a lot to them. The restrictions and censorship in Iran are a bit like the British weather: one day it's sunny, the next day it's raining. You just have to hope you walk out into the sunshine.
quotes.author: Asghar Farhadi

quotes.quote: Hope for the best, survive the worst, find humor wherever you can.
quotes.author: Claire Scovell LaZebnik

quotes.quote: I've realized the extraordinary power of sports to heal, unite and inspire. I believe the Olympics will serve as the ultimate platform to provide positive changes and I hope to inspire all of Japan through my strong showing there.
quotes.author: Kohei Uchimura

quotes.quote: I write some country music. There's a song called 'I Hope You Dance.' Incredible. I was going to write that poem; somebody beat me to it.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: The reason I never give up hope is because everything is so basically hopeless.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: Success or failure depends more upon attitude than upon capacity successful men act as though they have accomplished or are enjoying something. Soon it becomes a reality. Act, look, feel successful, conduct yourself accordingly, and you will be amazed at the positive results.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.quote: I'm not the kind of person who likes to shout out my personal issues from the rooftops, but with my bipolar becoming public, I hope fellow sufferers will know it's completely controllable. I hope I can help remove any stigma attached to it, and that those who don't have it under control will seek help with all that is available to treat it.
quotes.author: Catherine Zeta-Jones

quotes.quote: There is no reason why challenging themes and engaging stories have to be mutually exclusive - in fact, each can fuel the other. As a filmmaker, I want to entertain people first and foremost. If out of that comes a greater awareness and understanding of a time or a circumstance, then the hope is that change can happen.
quotes.author: Edward Zwick

quotes.quote: To me, one of the best faces America has ever projected is the face of a Peace Corps volunteer. That face symbolizes this country: young, curious, brimming with idealism and hope - and a real, honest compassion.
quotes.author: Teresa Heinz

quotes.quote: If you wish to succeed in life, make perseverance your bosom friend, experience your wise counselor, caution your elder brother, and hope your guardian genius.
quotes.author: Joseph Addison

quotes.quote: Woe to the man whose heart has not learned while young to hope, to love - and to put its trust in life.
quotes.author: Joseph Conrad

quotes.quote: Yesterday I was a dog. Today I'm a dog. Tomorrow I'll probably still be a dog. Sigh! There's so little hope for advancement.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.quote: The secret is not to give up hope. It's very hard not to because if you're really doing something worthwhile I think you will be pushed to the brink of hopelessness before you come through the other side.
quotes.author: George Lucas

quotes.quote: The essence of optimism is that it takes no account of the present, but it is a source of inspiration, of vitality and hope where others have resigned; it enables a man to hold his head high, to claim the future for himself and not to abandon it to his enemy.
quotes.author: Dietrich Bonhoeffer

quotes.quote: People don't believe or understand that a community can lose hope. You can have a whole community where hopelessness is the norm, where folks don't have faith that things will get better because history and circumstances have proven over 30, 40, or 50 years that things don't get better.
quotes.author: Geoffrey Canada

quotes.quote: I totally disagree with the view that the Tibet struggle will die, and there will be no hope for Tibet, after the Dalai Lama passes away.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.quote: You learn timing on the road. You learn structure and how to read an audience. You learn so much about the business of laughter that you can't learn on a set, because it's all on you. Sometimes you bomb, and you know not to tell that joke again... You just hope people find the humor in the awkwardness.
quotes.author: Marlon Wayans

quotes.quote: If a man like Malcolm X could change and repudiate racism, if I myself and other former Muslims can change, if young whites can change, then there is hope for America.
quotes.author: Eldridge Cleaver

quotes.quote: Hope is necessary in every condition. The miseries of poverty, sickness and captivity would, without this comfort, be insupportable.
quotes.author: William Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: Maybe all one can do is hope to end up with the right regrets.
quotes.author: Arthur Miller

quotes.quote: I hope that I inspire women to believe in themselves, no matter where they come from; no matter what education they have; what particular background they originate from.
quotes.author: Madonna Ciccone

quotes.quote: It's true that General Musharraf opposes my return, seeing me as a symbol of democracy in the country. He is comfortable with dictatorship. I hope better sense prevails.
quotes.author: Benazir Bhutto

quotes.quote: The sparrow that is twittering on the edge of my balcony is calling up to me this moment a world of memories that reach over half my lifetime, and a world of hope that stretches farther than any flight of sparrows.
quotes.author: Donald G. Mitchell

quotes.quote: God gives me hope that there is something greater than us, something better and bigger than the here and now, that can help us live.
quotes.author: Mattie Stepanek

quotes.quote: Hope and Change has become Divide and Conquer.
quotes.author: Marco Rubio

quotes.quote: There is a part of me that still wants to go out and grab a backpack and unplug - not take a cellphone or even a camera and just get out there and experience the world and travel. I have yet to do that, but someday I hope.
quotes.author: Emilio Estevez

quotes.quote: I think you grow wherever God plants you. I hope I'm growing as a person of faith, as a Christian. That should be our number one objective this journey of life. That all starts with a personal intimate relationship with Christ and then being in prayer every single day about all of those things - being tenacious about it.
quotes.author: J. C. Watts

quotes.quote: The great hope of society is in individual character.
quotes.author: William Ellery Channing

quotes.quote: I hope that by modeling feminism in my own life, work and relationships that it will haut become an organic part of my daughter's life. But I'm also fully prepared for her to become a Republican as a way to rebel as a teenager - that would be just my luck!
quotes.author: Jessica Valenti

quotes.quote: I hope that I'm always struggling, really. You develop when you're struggling. When you're struggling, you get stronger.
quotes.author: Andrew Garfield

quotes.quote: I do feel strongly that string theory is our best hope for making progress at unifying gravity and quantum mechanics.
quotes.author: Brian Greene

quotes.quote: Religion kept some of my relatives alive, because it was all they had. If they hadn't had some hope of heaven, some companionship in Jesus, they probably would have committed suicide, their lives were so hellish.
quotes.author: Octavia Butler

quotes.quote: Together we will build an America where hope is a new job with a paycheck, not a faded word on an old bumper sticker.
quotes.author: Mitt Romney

quotes.quote: Like all of us in this storm between birth and death, I can wreak no great changes on the world, only small changes for the better, I hope, in the lives of those I love.
quotes.author: Dean Koontz

quotes.quote: We must not lose hope. Hope is an anchor to the souls of men. Satan would have us cast away that anchor.
quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson

quotes.quote: We need international support so that our people live a life of normality, of dignity, of liberty and freedom. I hope that our cry for freedom may be heard.
quotes.author: Mahmoud Abbas

quotes.quote: Your ordinary acts of love and hope point to the extraordinary promise that every human life is of inestimable value.
quotes.author: Desmond Tutu

quotes.quote: A lot of presidential memoirs, they say, are dull and self-serving. I hope mine is interesting and self-serving.
quotes.author: William J. Clinton

quotes.quote: Without hope we are lost.
quotes.author: Mahmoud Darwish

quotes.quote: I hope somebody falls in love with me - other than my fiancee. But that's what you want. As a player you want a team that really wants you; head coach, GM, owner, everybody that really wants you in their place and the players believe in you. I'm looking forward to making somebody fall in love with me.
quotes.author: Robert Griffin III

quotes.quote: Even in the hardest circumstances, dreams can give you the courage to live, and I hope I can share that message with children in need.
quotes.author: Kim Yuna

quotes.quote: Friends from the press, China needs to learn more about the world, and the world also needs to learn more about China. I hope you will continue to make more efforts and contributions to deepening the mutual understanding between China and the countries of the world.
quotes.author: Xi Jinping

quotes.quote: Hope lies in having more faith in the power of God to heal us than in the power of anything to hurt or destroy us. In realizing that as children of God we are bigger than our problems, we have the power at last to confront them.
quotes.author: Marianne Williamson

quotes.quote: I'm going to sit back, light up, and hope I don't chew the cigarette to pieces.
quotes.author: Vin Scully

quotes.quote: When we love, we always strive to become better than we are. When we strive to become better than we are, everything around us becomes better too.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

quotes.quote: Our hope in life beyond death is a hope made possible, not by some general sentimental belief in life after death, but by our participation in the life of Christ.
quotes.author: Stanley Hauerwas

quotes.quote: Hope, the best comfort of our imperfect condition.
quotes.author: Edward Gibbon

quotes.quote: My hope is that we continue to nurture the places that we love, but that we also look outside our immediate worlds.
quotes.author: Annie Leibovitz

quotes.quote: Why do people play the lottery, or why do people gamble, period? You know, it's with the hope of winning something more.
quotes.author: Derek Kilmer

quotes.quote: Over the years, I had nurtured the hope to be able to fly; to handle a machine as it rose higher and higher in the stratosphere was my dearest dream.
quotes.author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

quotes.quote: Man's only true happiness is to live in hope of something to be won by him. Reverence something to be worshipped by him, and love something to be cherished by him, forever.
quotes.author: John Ruskin

quotes.quote: Few people know so clearly what they want. Most people can't even think what to hope for when they throw a penny in a fountain.
quotes.author: Barbara Kingsolver

quotes.quote: Fear cannot be without hope nor hope without fear.
quotes.author: Baruch Spinoza

quotes.quote: I sincerely hope I can contribute to the progress there has been in relations between Jews and Catholics since the Second Vatican Council in a spirit of renewed collaboration.
quotes.author: Pope Francis

quotes.quote: Of the big horror movies of the '70s, you have 'The Omen,' 'The Sentinel,' 'Rosemary's Baby,' 'The Stepford Wives,' 'Burnt Offerings' - these are all romantic fatalist movies where there's a sort of glimmer of hope... but darkness wins.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk

quotes.quote: I really feel like life will dictate itself. You should allow it to unfold as naturally as possible. Just go with the flow. When you're really desperate, you say a few prayers and hope for the best. That's the way I've always lived my life.
quotes.author: Shania Twain

quotes.quote: You probably found 'How to Survive a Robot Uprising' in the humor section. Let's just hope that is where it belongs.
quotes.author: Daniel H. Wilson

quotes.quote: When push comes to shove, it ain't the science that's going to lift you up - it's the belief, the spiritual side of life, that's going to lift you up, no matter what religion you are.
quotes.author: Kirstie Alley

quotes.quote: All parents hope and pray that their children will make wise decisions. Children who are obedient and responsible bring to their parents unending pride and satisfaction.
quotes.author: James E. Faust

quotes.quote: I had to stop going to auditions thinking, 'Oh, I hope they like me.' I had to go in thinking I was the answer to their problem.
quotes.author: George Clooney

quotes.quote: I hope all you young girls see yourself up there... we were just like you.
quotes.author: Mia Hamm

quotes.quote: When you put something out there into the world, there's all these words you don't want to hear, that you hope people don't say. I don't like anything that starts with 're' - like retro, reinvent, recreate - I hate that. It's always like living in the past - copying, emulating.
quotes.author: Jack White

quotes.quote: I hope people remember me as a guy who brought magic to the people. You know, pushed the boundaries of wonder.
quotes.author: David Blaine

quotes.quote: I get asked to read new works a lot, in the hope that I will give a quotation and I will only give a 'puff' for a book I truly love.
quotes.author: Peter James

quotes.quote: When we have lost everything, including hope, life becomes a disgrace, and death a duty.
quotes.author: W. C. Fields

quotes.quote: It's a good place when all you have is hope and not expectations.
quotes.author: Danny Boyle

quotes.quote: Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not; remember that what you now have was once among the things you only hoped for.
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.quote: I like the night. Without the dark, we'd never see the stars.
quotes.author: Stephenie Meyer,  Twilight

quotes.quote: One lives in the hope of becoming a memory.
quotes.author: Antonio Porchia

quotes.quote: There is hope in dreams, imagination, and in the courage of those who wish to make those dreams a reality.
quotes.author: Jonas Salk

quotes.quote: The capacity for hope is the most significant fact of life. It provides human beings with a sense of destination and the energy to get started.
quotes.author: Norman Cousins

quotes.quote: Extreme hopes are born from extreme misery.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: A whole stack of memories never equal one little hope.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.quote: Hold fast to dreams,For if dreams dieLife is a broken-winged bird,That cannot fly.
quotes.author: Langston Hughes

quotes.quote: He that lives upon hope will die fasting.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: The sudden disappointment of a hope leaves a scar which the ultimate fulfillment of that hope never entirely removes.
quotes.author: Thomas Hardy

quotes.quote: I always entertain great hopes.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.quote: Hope is like peace. It is not a gift from God. It is a gift only we can give one another.
quotes.author: Elie Wiesel

quotes.quote: With optimism, you look upon the sunny side of things. People say, 'Studs, you're an optimist.' I never said I was an optimist. I have hope because what's the alternative to hope? Despair? If you have despair, you might as well put your head in the oven.
quotes.author: Studs Terkel

quotes.quote: You all know that I have been sustained throughout my life by three saving graces - my family, my friends, and a faith in the power of resilience and hope. These graces have carried me through difficult times and they have brought more joy to the good times than I ever could have imagined.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Edwards

quotes.quote: But Hopes are Shy Birds flying at a great distance seldom reached by the best of Guns.
quotes.author: John James Audubon

quotes.quote: Lord save us all from old age and broken health and a hope tree that has lost the faculty of putting out blossoms.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: God grant me the courage not to give up what I think is right even though I think it is hopeless.
quotes.author: Chester W. Nimitz

quotes.quote: All kids need is a little help, a little hope and somebody who believes in them.
quotes.author: Magic Johnson

quotes.quote: The theological virtue of hope is the patient and trustful willingness to live without closure, without resolution, and still be content and even happy because our Satisfaction is now at another level, and our Source is beyond ourselves.
quotes.author: Richard Rohr

quotes.quote: Tomorrow hopes we have learned something from yesterday.
quotes.author: John Wayne

quotes.quote: Hope is a waking dream.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: In the end, that's what this election is about. Do we participate in a politics of cynicism or a politics of hope?
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: There is no medicine like hope, no incentive so great, and no tonic so powerful as expectation of something tomorrow.
quotes.author: Orison Swett Marden

quotes.quote: Be prepared, work hard, and hope for a little luck. Recognize that the harder you work and the better prepared you are, the more luck you might have.
quotes.author: Ed Bradley

quotes.quote: Hopeful thinking can get you out of your fear zone and into your appreciation zone.
quotes.author: Martha Beck

quotes.quote: There can be hope only for a society which acts as one big family, not as many separate ones.
quotes.author: Anwar Sadat

quotes.quote: One loves to possess arms, though they hope never to have occasion for them.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: On the first day of school, you got to be real careful where you sit. You walk into the classroom and just plunk your stuff down on any old desk, and the next thing you know the teacher is saying, 'I hope you all like where you're sitting, because these are your permanent seats.'
quotes.author: Jeff Kinney

quotes.quote: Behaving morally because of a hope of reward or a fear of punishment is not morality. Morality is not bribery or threats. Religion is bribery and threats. Humans have morality. We don't need religion.
quotes.author: Penn Jillette

quotes.quote: The youth is the hope of our future.
quotes.author: Jose Rizal

quotes.quote: Any people anywhere, being inclined and having the power, have the right to rise up, and shake off the existing government, and form a new one that suits them better. This is a most valuable - a most sacred right - a right, which we hope and believe, is to liberate the world.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: We must restore hope to young people, help the old, be open to the future, spread love. Be poor among the poor. We need to include the excluded and preach peace.
quotes.author: Pope Francis

quotes.quote: I hope we shall crush in its birth the aristocracy of our monied corporations which dare already to challenge our government to a trial by strength, and bid defiance to the laws of our country.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: Most of the important things in the world have been accomplished by people who have kept on trying when there seemed to be no hope at all.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: What greater aspiration and challenge are there for a mother than the hope of raising a great son or daughter?
quotes.author: Rose Kennedy

quotes.quote: I only hope that we don't lose sight of one thing - that it was all started by a mouse.
quotes.author: Walt Disney

quotes.quote: The human body experiences a powerful gravitational pull in the direction of hope. That is why the patient's hopes are the physician's secret weapon. They are the hidden ingredients in any prescription.
quotes.author: Norman Cousins

quotes.quote: We all hope for breakthrough rebirth moments.
quotes.author: Dane Cook

quotes.quote: If the skies fall, one may hope to catch larks.
quotes.author: Francois Rabelais

quotes.quote: Hope, like faith, is nothing if it is not courageous; it is nothing if it is not ridiculous.
quotes.author: Thornton Wilder

quotes.quote: It's really a wonder that I haven't dropped all my ideals, because they seem so absurd and impossible to carry out. Yet I keep them, because in spite of everything, I still believe that people are really good at heart.
quotes.author: Anne Frank,  The Diary of a Young Girl

quotes.quote: Hope, deceiving as it is, serves at least to lead us to the end of our lives by an agreeable route.
quotes.author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quotes.quote: Hope is itself a species of happiness, and, perhaps, the chief happiness, which this world affords.
quotes.author: William Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: We hope that through these trade arrangements, through collaboration in training, in manpower development, and what have you, ASEAN in, say, ten years' time, will be a very different ASEAN.
quotes.author: Sellapan Ramanathan

quotes.quote: I have had extremely good relations with the United States and with both parties (Republicans and Democrats), and I hope to continue to have these good relations, which I, again repeating, do not consider to be mutually exclusive with having good relations with Venezuela or Ecuador or whichever country in South America.
quotes.author: Juan Manuel Santos

quotes.quote: I certainly notice the vitality in Belfast, which wasn't there in the Seventies. There was a war going on then. Now there are cranes everywhere. There really is a sense of renewal and hope.
quotes.author: Liam Neeson

quotes.quote: I'd be happy to live till 80 as long as I was comfortable and in good health. Mind you, ask me again on the eve of my 80th birthday. Even so, I hope we don't all start living to be 120. I'm not sure I'd cope with another 60 years.
quotes.author: Bonnie Tyler

quotes.quote: The planet's hope and salvation lies in the adoption of revolutionary new knowledge being revealed at the frontiers of science.
quotes.author: Bruce Lipton

quotes.quote: I hope that at the end of the seven years, people will say that I have been of some inspirational value to them at home in terms of inclusiveness and abroad, I look forward to representing Ireland.
quotes.author: Michael D. Higgins

quotes.quote: Candidate Obama was either exceptionally naive or willfully disingenuous when he vowed to change the way Washington works. The very promise of Hope and Change was rooted in uprooting the Washington modus operandi. But instead of rejecting it, he embraced it all - the secrecy, the closed doors, the political favors, the near-criminal negligence.
quotes.author: Reince Priebus

quotes.quote: When it comes down to it, it's giving people a good night out in a basic way and I think my company guarantees that. There's always something new and something to excite us and surprise us, and that's why people come back, I hope.
quotes.author: Matthew Bourne

quotes.quote: There are certain things about me that I will never tell to anyone because I am a very private person. But basically, what you see is who I am. I'm independent, I do like to be liked, I do look for the good side of life and people. I'm positive, I'm disciplined, I like my life in order, and I'm neat as a pin.
quotes.author: Mary Tyler Moore

quotes.quote: The only way of knowing a person is to love them without hope.
quotes.author: Walter Benjamin

quotes.quote: When a man becomes a Christian, he becomes industrious, trustworthy and prosperous. Now, if that man, when he gets all he can and saves all he can, does not give all he can, I have more hope for Judas Iscariot than for that man!
quotes.author: John Wesley

quotes.quote: So many people grew up with challenges, as I did. There weren't always happy things happening to me or around me. But when you look at the core of goodness within yourself - at the optimism and hope - you realize it comes from the environment you grew up in.
quotes.author: Sonia Sotomayor

quotes.quote: I do protect human rights, and I hope I shall always be looked up as a champion of human rights.
quotes.author: Aung San Suu Kyi

quotes.quote: That's all a man can hope for during his lifetime - to set an example - and when he is dead, to be an inspiration for history.
quotes.author: William McKinley

quotes.quote: A pessimist sees the difficulty in every opportunity; an optimist sees the opportunity in every difficulty.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: You accept that this civilisation could be abolished and life will begin later on after a few thousand years because that is something that has happened in the history of this planet. When you have peace in yourself and accept, then you are calm enough to do something, but if you are carried by despair there is no hope.
quotes.author: Thich Nhat Hanh

quotes.quote: Art is the most beautiful deception of all. And although people try to incorporate the everyday events of life in it, we must hope that it will remain a deception lest it become a utilitarian thing, sad as a factory.
quotes.author: Claude Debussy

quotes.quote: To withdraw is not to run away, and to stay is no wise action, when there's more reason to fear than to hope.
quotes.author: Miguel de Cervantes

quotes.quote: God's way of answering the Christian's prayer for more patience, experience, hope and love often is to put him into the furnace of affliction.
quotes.author: Richard Cecil

quotes.quote: I hope I never get so old I get religious.
quotes.author: Ingmar Bergman

quotes.quote: Between the fear that something would happen and the hope that still it wouldn't, there is much more space than one thinks. On that narrow, hard, bare and dark space a lot of us spend their lives.
quotes.author: Ivo Andric

quotes.quote: Like success, failure is many things to many people. With Positive Mental Attitude, failure is a learning experience, a rung on the ladder, a plateau at which to get your thoughts in order and prepare to try again.
quotes.author: W. Clement Stone

quotes.quote: When we create hope and opportunity in the lives of others, we allow love, decency and promise to triumph over cowardice and hate.
quotes.author: Kirsten Gillibrand

quotes.quote: When Nelson Mandela walked free, the world sang with joy. Ever since, South Africa has stood as a beacon of hope for Africa.
quotes.author: Ban Ki-moon

quotes.quote: Corporations, consumers, and citizens must begin acting in concert to create a powerful third pillar of social transformation if we hope to meet the social challenges we currently face with equal force. This begins with corporations that choose to alter how they practice capitalism in two ways to serve the greater good.
quotes.author: Simon Mainwaring

quotes.quote: In acting, there's a type of courage you're recognized for all the time. You lose 100 pounds and play a guy with AIDS, and you get rewarded. But, in life, doing what is courageous is quiet, and no one knows about it. Courage is someone making sacrifices for their family or making selfless decisions for what they hope or feel.
quotes.author: Rob Lowe

quotes.quote: I hope people remember me for the kind of person that I am, not because of what I do.
quotes.author: Sean Faris

quotes.quote: As I hope it doesn't come to the point where I need to take a day off. I feel pretty good right now and I'm not resting or saving for any other game.
quotes.author: Tim Duncan

quotes.quote: If there's a golf course in heaven, I hope it's like Augusta National. I just don't want an early tee time.
quotes.author: Gary Player

quotes.quote: One year, my good deed started with deciding to give all my friends makeup from a cruelty-free cosmetics line that I love. I did this with the hope that they would love it as much as I do and end up switching their makeup over to that cruelty-free line forever.
quotes.author: Jenna Morasca

quotes.quote: Being insecure - I'm a master, a virtuoso - they can be handing me the keys to the kingdom and all I can think is, I hope I don't drop the key.
quotes.author: M. Night Shyamalan

quotes.quote: You have to find hope. Hope is such a shape shifter. You tend to look in the rearview mirror for hope, but when it's gone, you have to look forward. You have to get in the van and keep driving on.
quotes.author: Jonathan Evison

quotes.quote: Urgent optimism is the desire to act immediately to tackle an obstacle, combined with the belief that we have a reasonable hope of success.
quotes.author: Jane McGonigal

quotes.quote: I hope that a move toward clemency with Judge Afiuni would be a step towards the importance of maintaining a properly functioning justice system.
quotes.author: Noam Chomsky

quotes.quote: When I think about the world I would like to leave to my daughter and the grandchildren I hope to have, it is a world that moves away from unequal, unstable, unsustainable interdependence to integrated communities - locally, nationally and globally - that share the characteristics of all successful communities.
quotes.author: William J. Clinton

quotes.quote: Let's drink to the spirit of gallantry and courage that made a strange Heaven out of unbelievable Hell, and let's drink to the hope that one day this country of ours, which we love so much, will find dignity and greatness and peace again.
quotes.author: Noel Coward

quotes.quote: The whole point of Superman, as originally created, was to be the ally of those who had no other allies. It put that magnitude of power, the most powerful guy in the world, in the service of those who had no hope, no chance.
quotes.author: J. Michael Straczynski

quotes.quote: I'm different, and I have to be a warrior to be that way. But I have had some success; I hope I have touched the lives of some wonderful people, all by being what I see as myself but some others people see as different.
quotes.author: Johnny Weir

quotes.quote: Unless our conception of patriotism is progressive, it cannot hope to embody the real affection and the real interest of the nation.
quotes.author: Jane Addams

quotes.quote: Being a star has made it possible for me to get insulted in places where the average Negro could never hope to go and get insulted.
quotes.author: Sammy Davis, Jr.

quotes.quote: I think of myself as a catalyst of action and a messenger of hope, turning people onto themselves and turning people onto their dreams.
quotes.author: Les Brown

quotes.quote: If we ever hope to rid the world of the political AIDS of our time, terrorism, the rule must be clear: One does not deal with terrorists; one does not bargain with terrorists; one kills terrorists.
quotes.author: Meir Kahane

quotes.quote: My husband John Lennon was a very special man. A man of humble origin, he brought light and hope to the whole world with his words and music.
quotes.author: Yoko Ono

quotes.quote: There will always be someone else with a different view than you. I appreciate them and would never say that they are wrong. I hope that they would give me that courtesy also.
quotes.author: Melissa Etheridge

quotes.quote: 'Life, Love & Hope' is... I'm thinking 'larger picture.' I'm not trying to preach to anyone. We all get lost and caught up in our everyday problems. Your cellphone doesn't work or you got a parking ticket, you had a bad day at work. You can lose sight of the really important things in life; that's what the song is about.
quotes.author: Tom Scholz

quotes.quote: To me, it's always been a challenge to look for the light: to look for those spaces in your heart where there is hope and faith and try to embrace that rather than crush it. I've spent so many years trying to crush those feelings of hope, and I certainly succeeded for quite a while.
quotes.author: Dave Gahan

quotes.quote: Here is just the beginning of a list of skills that exam results cannot possibly hope to reflect: interpersonal skills, the ability to entertain, how articulate we are as speakers, our ability to work as part of a team, the ability to deal with challenges and invention.
quotes.author: Alexandra Adornetto

quotes.quote: I hope that there's a difference between being childish and childlike and that I'm the latter, if you take my meaning. I often sort of wonder. I don't think I'm a terribly good grown-up; I don't take responsibility easily or well in many areas of life. Finance and stuff like that, I'm absolutely appalling.
quotes.author: Graeme Base

quotes.quote: Depression can seem worse than terminal cancer, because most cancer patients feel loved and they have hope and self-esteem.
quotes.author: David D. Burns

quotes.quote: Hope is the thing with feathers That perches in the soul And sings the tune without the words And never stops at all.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.quote: When my dad founded our church, he used either a globe or a map of the world behind him. It was symbolic of what Christ said: to go forth and preach hope to the world. We believe in the cross, but we just continued with the globe.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: Every parent is at some time the father of the unreturned prodigal, with nothing to do but keep his house open to hope.
quotes.author: John Ciardi

quotes.quote: If you start in the pit of despair with these profane, awful things, even a glimmer of hope or awareness is going to occur that's much brighter coming from this dark, awful beginning.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk

quotes.quote: Anytime someone says your God is ugly and you release your God and join their God, there is no hope for your freedom until you once more believe in your own concept of the 'deity.'
quotes.author: John Henrik Clarke

quotes.quote: My contribution I hope is to get people to eat full-flavored food. If I could come away with that alone, that would be a fantastic accomplishment. I'm also very proud of being a very American chef.
quotes.author: Bobby Flay

quotes.quote: One of the things I like best about 'Biggest Loser' is being around people who are trying to make the right choices. When you feel defeated about your weight and your health, like there's no hope, and you still make the choice to fight for it, to make the change happen no matter what people say or think, that's inspiring to me.
quotes.author: Alison Sweeney

quotes.quote: My dad is so unique in what he does. It's not like I'm taking a torch from him and doing his thing. I hope I've carried from him a little bit of a sense of irony, a little bit of a wink.
quotes.author: Willie Geist

quotes.quote: I hope to be the go-to person on international trade and industry. I think no one before me or after me will ever have so much knowledge about America's ports.
quotes.author: Janice Hahn

quotes.quote: I hope I'm in a position to make stuff that I really want to make as opposed to stuff that I just have to make for money reasons, or to sustain a certain marquee value.
quotes.author: Paul Walker

quotes.quote: My mother hoped I would meet a nice doctor or barrister or accountant who would marry me and take me to live in what is now called Fashionable Dublin Four. But she felt that this was a vain hope. I was a bit loud to make a nice professional wife, and anyway, I was too keen on spending my holidays in far flung places to meet any of these people.
quotes.author: Maeve Binchy

quotes.quote: I love being able to sing for my job. I am blessed beyond words and I hope my fans can feel that while I'm on stage!
quotes.author: Jordin Sparks

quotes.quote: To many, peace is what enables development and is critical in providing opportunities to young people. To some - especially those from regions involved in conflict - peacekeeping and efforts to preserve peace are absolutely vital in bringing prosperity and hope for the future.
quotes.author: Kim Yuna

quotes.quote: It's a pity that the tennis is really going down the drain. Every year it's getting worse and worse and worse. There has to be a radical change, and I hope it will be really soon.
quotes.author: Marat Safin

quotes.quote: My main hope is eventually, in modern education field, introduce education about warm-heartedness, not based on religion, but based on common experience and a common sort of sense, and then scientific finding.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.quote: Expect to have hope rekindled. Expect your prayers to be answered in wondrous ways. The dry seasons in life do not last. The spring rains will come again.
quotes.author: Sarah Ban Breathnach

quotes.quote: At least one reason for trying to live lives that make a difference is that by so living, we hope we will not be forgotten by those who benefit from our trying to make a difference.
