Yet to try to insure we will not be forgotten too often results in desperate manipulative strategies that are doomed to fail.
quotes.author: Stanley Hauerwas

quotes.quote: I'm thrilled to continue my partnership with U by Kotex for Generation Know while helping to empower girls. I've always been a motivational resource for my younger sisters and hope I can positively impact and inspire other young girls too.
quotes.author: Khloe Kardashian

quotes.quote: The chemistry of love is something which is extremely extremely unbelievable. This is something we have planned for more than two years, so I hope that we are going to start in the beginning of next year.
quotes.author: Lennart Nilsson

quotes.quote: Everyone wants clean air and clean water, but my hope is that we will not regulate it to the point where we drive businesses and industries out of this country, to the point where entrepreneurs cannot start or expand their businesses because they simply can't afford to do so.
quotes.author: Bob Latta

quotes.quote: I have always thought of poems as stepping stones in one's own sense of oneself. Every now and again, you write a poem that gives you self-respect and steadies your going a little bit farther out in the stream. At the same time, you have to conjure the next stepping stone because the stream, we hope, keeps flowing.
quotes.author: Seamus Heaney

quotes.quote: A good question is never answered. It is not a bolt to be tightened into place but a seed to be planted and to bear more seed toward the hope of greening the landscape of idea.
quotes.author: John Ciardi

quotes.quote: The past is a source of knowledge, and the future is a source of hope. Love of the past implies faith in the future.
quotes.author: Stephen Ambrose

quotes.quote: I hope I'm wrong, but I am afraid that Iraq is going to turn out to be the greatest disaster in American foreign policy - worse than Vietnam, not in the number who died, but in terms of its unintended consequences and its reverberation throughout the region.
quotes.author: Madeleine Albright

quotes.quote: We hope President Obama will now respect the will of the people, change course, and commit to making the changes they are demanding. To the extent he is willing to do this, we are ready to work with him.
quotes.author: John Boehner

quotes.quote: Certain it is that a great responsibility rests upon the statesmen of all nations, not only to fulfill the promises for reduction in armaments, but to maintain the confidence of the people of the world in the hope of an enduring peace.
quotes.author: Frank B. Kellogg

quotes.quote: I feel like if you enjoyed the 119 hours that precede the finale of 'Lost,' is that whole experience ruined by the fact that you might not agree with everything that we did in the finale? I would hope not! I would hope that you would appreciate the fact that you were entertained for 119 hours even if you didn't love the finale.
quotes.author: Carlton Cuse

quotes.quote: Your attitude is like a box of crayons that color your world. Constantly color your picture gray, and your picture will always be bleak. Try adding some bright colors to the picture by including humor, and your picture begins to lighten up.
quotes.author: Allen Klein

quotes.quote: If you're reading this...Congratulations, you're alive.If that's not something to smile about,then I don't know what is.
quotes.author: Chad Sugg,  Monsters Under Your Head

quotes.quote: The present is the ever moving shadow that divides yesterday from tomorrow. In that lies hope.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quotes.quote: Together we can make a world where cancer no longer means living with fear, without hope, or worse.
quotes.author: Patrick Swayze

quotes.quote: I am a beneficiary of the American people's generosity, and I hope we can have comprehensive immigration legislation that allows this country to continue to be enriched by those who were not born here.
quotes.author: Madeleine Albright

quotes.quote: When it's said and done, the one thing I want to leave on this earth is hope. I have felt hopelessness, and it's a terrible feeling. Hopelessness will destroy you. I want to bring hope to other people.
quotes.author: Paula Deen

quotes.quote: Beauty products always cheer me up and give me hope. If it makes you feel pretty, why not?
quotes.author: Salma Hayek

quotes.quote: I hope I'm not a tourist attraction - I'm sure that they come here really because St. Andrews is just amazing, a beautiful place.
quotes.author: Prince William

quotes.quote: Writing your own jokes, you just kind of keep working on something until you think it might work, and then you try it out and hope for the best.
quotes.author: Aziz Ansari

quotes.quote: D.C. fans, I think, are so good. They just come up to me, and they're so nice and so polite and just, 'Hey, I hope you have a great career,' and 'How are you doing, everything's good?' That's pretty much where they leave it at.
quotes.author: Bryce Harper

quotes.quote: I'm direct, I'm unpretentious and I'm pretty dogged, and I hope I've got a capacity to laugh at myself and not take myself too seriously.
quotes.author: John Howard

quotes.quote: I hope that five years and ten years from now, I'll be a better man, a more mature man, a wiser man, a more humble man and a more spirited man to serve the good of my people and the good of humanity.
quotes.author: Louis Farrakhan

quotes.quote: I testify that inspiration can be the spring for every person's hope, guidance, and strength. It is one of the magnified treasures of life. It involves coming to the infinite knowledge of God.
quotes.author: James E. Faust

quotes.quote: Hope is like a harebell trembling from its birth.
quotes.author: Christina Rossetti

quotes.quote: Running fills a need so we make fewer demands on others. Running reveals the roots of negative thinking, so the weeds can be pulled. Running reconnects the soul to the source, inspiring hope and creativity.
quotes.author: Kristin Armstrong

quotes.quote: I love Madrid. I am happy to be here. I have been here three years and hope to be here longer. But I am proud of where I come from and never forget the people I grew up with.
quotes.author: Zinedine Zidane

quotes.quote: But maybe music was not intended to satisfy the curious definiteness of man. Maybe it is better to hope that music may always be transcendental language in the most extravagant sense.
quotes.author: Charles Ives

quotes.quote: Your life has to consist of more than 'Black people should unite.' You hope they do, but not twenty-four hours a day.
quotes.author: Gil Scott-Heron

quotes.quote: You can't make people change, but the organizers of WorldFest hope that people consider being vegetarian for both moral and health reasons.
quotes.author: Grace Slick

quotes.quote: I was the guy who was friends with everybody. Yes, I had my core group of friends, but I wasn't part of a clique that excluded people. I hope they thought I was a nice guy. I tried to be just friendly and outgoing. I was class president. I'm supposed to run my class reunion in 2013.
quotes.author: Austin Stowell

quotes.quote: My message to you all is of hope, courage and confidence. Let us mobilize all our resources in a systematic and organized way and tackle the grave issues that confront us with grim determination and discipline worthy of a great nation.
quotes.author: Muhammad Ali Jinnah

quotes.quote: Darkness comes. In the middle of it, the future looks blank. The temptation to quit is huge. Don't. You are in good company... You will argue with yourself that there is no way forward. But with God, nothing is impossible. He has more ropes and ladders and tunnels out of pits than you can conceive. Wait. Pray without ceasing. Hope.
quotes.author: John Piper

quotes.quote: My favorite fruit is grapes. Because with grapes, you always get another chance. 'Cause, you know, if you have a crappy apple or a peach, you're stuck with that crappy piece of fruit. But if you have a crappy grape, no problem - just move on to the next. 'Grapes: The Fruit of Hope.'
quotes.author: Demetri Martin

quotes.quote: I'm not sure. But that bless-his/her-heart kind of melancholic humor is among my favorite things in the world. I guess it exposes a kind of humanity - or that's the hope, at least - a kind of grudging respect for human frailty. Unless it's actually kicking human frailty while it's down - I'm not sure.
quotes.author: David Rakoff

quotes.quote: There are no greater treasures than the highest human qualities such as compassion, courage and hope. Not even tragic accident or disaster can destroy such treasures of the heart.
quotes.author: Daisaku Ikeda

quotes.quote: They say a person needs just three things to be truly happy in this world: someone to love, something to do, and something to hope for.
quotes.author: Tom Bodett

quotes.quote: I hope I can compete in one or two Olympics in my career. Of course I would like to win a medal, but just being there would be awesome.
quotes.author: Patrick Chan

quotes.quote: If people are good only because they fear punishment, and hope for reward, then we are a sorry lot indeed.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Few things in the world are more powerful than a positive push. A smile. A world of optimism and hope. A 'you can do it' when things are tough.
quotes.author: Richard M. DeVos

quotes.quote: Our human compassion binds us the one to the other - not in pity or patronizingly, but as human beings who have learnt how to turn our common suffering into hope for the future.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.quote: If money is your hope for independence you will never have it. The only real security that a man will have in this world is a reserve of knowledge, experience, and ability.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.quote: Nothing is black or white, nothing's 'us or them.' But then there are magical, beautiful things in the world. There's incredible acts of kindness and bravery, and in the most unlikely places, and it gives you hope.
quotes.author: Dave Matthews

quotes.quote: Today's students can put dope in their veins or hope in their brains. If they can conceive it and believe it, they can achieve it. They must know it is not their aptitude but their attitude that will determine their altitude.
quotes.author: Jesse Jackson

quotes.quote: The sea, the great unifier, is man's only hope. Now, as never before, the old phrase has a literal meaning: we are all in the same boat.
quotes.author: Jacques Yves Cousteau

quotes.quote: I hope I inspire people who hear. Hearing people have the ability to remove barriers that prevent deaf people from achieving their dreams.
quotes.author: Marlee Matlin

quotes.quote: Given the scale of trauma caused by the genocide, Rwanda has indicated that however thin the hope of a community can be, a hero always emerges. Although no one can dare claim that it is now a perfect state, and that no more work is needed, Rwanda has risen from the ashes as a model or truth and reconciliation.
quotes.author: Wole Soyinka

quotes.quote: I wish I had invented blue jeans. They have expression, modesty, sex appeal, simplicity - all I hope for in my clothes.
quotes.author: Yves Saint Laurent

quotes.quote: Come, gentlemen, I hope we shall drink down all unkindness.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: Our uniqueness, our individuality, and our life experience molds us into fascinating beings. I hope we can embrace that. I pray we may all challenge ourselves to delve into the deepest resources of our hearts to cultivate an atmosphere of understanding, acceptance, tolerance, and compassion. We are all in this life together.
quotes.author: Linda Thompson

quotes.quote: You are as young as your self-confidence, as old as your fears; as young as your hope, as old as your despair.
quotes.author: Samuel Ullman

quotes.quote: The world is indeed full of peril, and in it there are many dark places; but still there is much that is fair, and though in all lands love is now mingled with grief, it grows perhaps the greater.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

quotes.quote: You just have to keep trying to do good work, and hope that it leads to more good work. I want to look back on my career and be proud of the work, and be proud that I tried everything. Yes, I want to look back and know that I was terrible at a variety of things.
quotes.author: Jon Stewart

quotes.quote: Where there's tea there's hope.
quotes.author: Arthur Wing Pinero

quotes.quote: I think it's realistic to have hope. One can be a perverse idealist and say the easiest thing: 'I despair. The world's no good.' That's a perverse idealist. It's practical to hope, because the hope is for us to survive as a human species. That's very realistic.
quotes.author: Studs Terkel

quotes.quote: You just hope that you will get the opportunity to do what you love and pay your bills, and that is being a success as an actor.
quotes.author: Debra Messing

quotes.quote: Next year, I hope there will be even more parties, lots of holidays and just having a good time, really. Plus wing-walking, air shows and learning to fly, as they are all things I want to do. I won't be restricted by age.
quotes.author: Carol Vorderman

quotes.quote: Neither should a ship rely on one small anchor, nor should life rest on a single hope.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: At the end of the day, we must go forward with hope and not backward by fear and division.
quotes.author: Jesse Jackson

quotes.quote: To live without Hope is to Cease to live.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

quotes.quote: I place no hope in my strength, nor in my works: but all my confidence is in God my protector, who never abandons those who have put all their hope and thought in him.
quotes.author: Francois Rabelais

quotes.quote: There is some good in this world, and it's worth fighting for.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Two Towers

quotes.quote: God's mercy and grace give me hope - for myself, and for our world.
quotes.author: Billy Graham

quotes.quote: Hope is a state of mind, not of the world. Hope, in this deep and powerful sense, is not the same as joy that things are going well, or willingness to invest in enterprises that are obviously heading for success, but rather an ability to work for something because it is good.
quotes.author: Vaclav Havel

quotes.quote: How disappointment tracks the steps of hope.
quotes.author: Letitia Elizabeth Landon

quotes.quote: I wish I could know everything ever, like that would be my wish - that's what I hope heaven is, that they tell you who shot JFK and all that stuff.
quotes.author: Louis C. K.

quotes.quote: Things start out as hopes and end up as habits.
quotes.author: Lillian Hellman

quotes.quote: We really feel happier when things look bleak. Hope is endurance. Hope is holding on and going on and trusting in the Lord.
quotes.author: Michael Novak

quotes.quote: While it is important for people to see your promise you must also remember that hope is the keeper of both happiness and disappointment, the father of both progress and failure.
quotes.author: Bryant H. McGill

quotes.quote: At the end of the day, all you can hope for is to go on. The older I get, the more I realize that just keeping on keeping on is what life's all about.
quotes.author: Janis Ian

quotes.quote: Uncertainty is the refuge of hope.
quotes.author: Henri Frederic Amiel

quotes.quote: If it were not for hopes, the heart would break.
quotes.author: Thomas Fuller

quotes.quote: When you say a situation or a person is hopeless, you are slamming the door in the face of God.
quotes.author: Charles L. Allen

quotes.quote: You believe that easily which you hope for earnestly.
quotes.author: Terence

quotes.quote: Commitment, belief and positive attitude are all important if you're going to be a success, whether you're in sports, in business or, as in my case, anthropology.
quotes.author: Donald Johanson

quotes.quote: Even if the hopes you started out with are dashed, hope has to be maintained.
quotes.author: Seamus Heaney

quotes.quote: My hope still is to leave the world a bit better than when I got here.
quotes.author: Jim Henson

quotes.quote: I have tried to keep on with my striving because this is the only hope I have of ever achieving anything worthwhile and lasting.
quotes.author: Arthur Ashe

quotes.quote: I hope to stand firm enough to not go backward, and yet not go forward fast enough to wreck the country's cause.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: In this world you've just got to hope for the best and prepare for the worst and take whatever God sends.
quotes.author: Lucy Maud Montgomery

quotes.quote: Be careful to leave your sons well instructed rather than rich, for the hopes of the instructed are better than the wealth of the ignorant.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: Isn't it the moment of most profound doubt that gives birth to new certainties? Perhaps hopelessness is the very soil that nourishes human hope; perhaps one could never find sense in life without first experiencing its absurdity.
quotes.author: Vaclav Havel

quotes.quote: Every day begins with an act of courage and hope: getting out of bed.
quotes.author: Mason Cooley

quotes.quote: Just as despair can come to one only from other human beings, hope, too, can be given to one only by other human beings.
quotes.author: Elie Wiesel

quotes.quote: I don't know what can be so dangerous about giving people hope.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: Today we bury his remains in the earth as a seed of immortality. Our hearts are full of sadness, yet at the same time of joyful hope and profound gratitude.
quotes.author: Pope Benedict XVI

quotes.quote: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

quotes.quote: I was always a fan of the old-style comics. I loved vaudeville. I loved Milton Berle, Dick Shawn, Phyllis Diller, Don Rickles, Charlie Callas, all those guys. Hilarious. I love the Bing Crosby and Bob Hope movies, and Abbott & Costello. My television influences were 'Monty Python's Flying Circus,' 'Benny Hill,' and 'Hee Haw.'
quotes.author: Larry the Cable Guy

quotes.quote: For generations, America has served as a beacon of hope and freedom for those outside her borders, and as a land of limitless opportunity for those risking everything to seek a better life. Their talents and contributions have continued to enrich our country.
quotes.author: Spencer Bachus

quotes.quote: You cannot have a positive life and a negative mind.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: In giving freedom to the slave, we assure freedom to the free - honorable alike in that we give and what we preserve. We shall nobly save, or meanly lose, the last best hope of earth.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Life's under no obligation to give us what we expect.
quotes.author: Margaret Mitchell

quotes.quote: Fifty percent of people won't vote, and fifty percent don't read newspapers. I hope it's the same fifty percent.
quotes.author: Gore Vidal

quotes.quote: The story of Christian reformation, revival, and renaissance underscores that the darkest hour is often just before the dawn, so we should always be people of hope and prayer, not gloom and defeatism. God the Holy Spirit can turn the situation around in five minutes.
quotes.author: Os Guinness

quotes.quote: The joy of life comes from our encounters with new experiences, and hence there is no greater joy than to have an endlessly changing horizon, for each day to have a new and different sun.
quotes.author: Christopher McCandless

quotes.quote: Studying is something I really love doing, and I just hope to have enough money for tuition.
quotes.author: Alexandra Kosteniuk

quotes.quote: My childhood was very difficult. I had every childhood disease and then some, but my parents didn't mollycoddle me. They left me to fight those battles on my own. I guess that was very Canadian, very stoic. But it's good. I had to become a warrior. I had to give up hope and find a substitute for hope that would be far more stable.
quotes.author: Joni Mitchell

quotes.quote: I believe in an India of pluralism and diversity, not of religious bigotry and caste politics. I believe in an India that is secure in itself and confident of its place in the world, an India that is a proud example of tolerance, freedom and hope for the downtrodden.
quotes.author: Shashi Tharoor

quotes.quote: Over the past few years, the road to confrontation has shown its consequences: loss of innocent lives, destruction and fear. Most costly, however, was the loss of hope. The most precious gift that you can present to your peoples over the coming weeks is renewed hope born out of tangible progress on the ground.
quotes.author: Abdallah II of Jordan

quotes.quote: I shall endeavour still further to prosecute this inquiry, an inquiry I trust not merely speculative, but of sufficient moment to inspire the pleasing hope of its becoming essentially beneficial to mankind.
quotes.author: Edward Jenner

quotes.quote: Desperation is the raw material of drastic change. Only those who can leave behind everything they have ever believed in can hope to escape.
quotes.author: William S. Burroughs

quotes.quote: Blessed is he who expects nothing, for he shall never be disappointed.
quotes.author: Alexander Pope

quotes.quote: The happy Union of these States is a wonder; their Constitution a miracle; their example the hope of Liberty throughout the world.
quotes.author: James Madison

quotes.quote: Every night when I go to bed, I hope that I may never wake again, and every morning renews my grief.
quotes.author: Franz Schubert

quotes.quote: It doesn't give me any satisfaction to think that my concerns will be validated by my grandchildren's generation. I would love to be wrong in everything. My grandchildren are my stake in the near future, and it's my great hope that they might one day say, 'Grandpa was part of a great movement that helped to turn things around.'
quotes.author: David Suzuki

quotes.quote: I've been pleased to work with so many wonderful stars through the years. This has been an amazing journey. I hope it continues.
quotes.author: Keanu Reeves

quotes.quote: There are hurdles, there are handicaps, hardships you have to face in life, but you hope for a great future.
quotes.author: Anil Kapoor

quotes.quote: I hope that some day the practice of producing cowpox in human beings will spread over the world - when that day comes, there will be no more smallpox.
quotes.author: Edward Jenner

quotes.quote: Revolution is a phase, a mood, like spring, and just as spring has its buds and showers, so revolution has its ebullience, its bravery, its hope, and its solidarity. Some of these things pass.
quotes.author: Rebecca Solnit

quotes.quote: I hope royalty continues forever. This is the thing that can contribute to peace throughout the world.
quotes.author: Yayoi Kusama

quotes.quote: You cannot swim for new horizons until you have courage to lose sight of the shore.
quotes.author: William Faulkner

quotes.quote: I don't really need to be remembered. I hope the music's remembered.
quotes.author: Jeff Buckley

quotes.quote: If pain must come, may it come quickly. Because I have a life to live, and I need to live it in the best way possible. If he has to make a choice, may he make it now. Then I will either wait for him or forget him.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  By the River Piedra I Sat Down and Wept

quotes.quote: I say if you fight terrorism, it's based in fear, but if you promote peace, it's based on hope.
quotes.author: Greg Mortenson

quotes.quote: Ali's got a left, Ali's got a right - when he knocks you down, you'll sleep for the night; and when you lie on the floor and the ref counts to ten, hope and pray that you never meet me again.
quotes.author: Muhammad Ali

quotes.quote: Acting, and the privilege of being able to do it for a living, is so important to me. I don't turn up and just hope for the best. I really fret about it. I do my homework; I prepare myself for the experience of playing a particular character.
quotes.author: Kate Winslet

quotes.quote: You're going to go through tough times - that's life. But I say, 'Nothing happens to you, it happens for you.' See the positive in negative events.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: I hope to live long enough to see my surviving comrades march side by side with the Union veterans along Pennsylvania Avenue, and then I will die happy.
quotes.author: James Longstreet

quotes.quote: I hope to make acting my career for the rest of my life, if I can.
quotes.author: Chloe Grace Moretz

quotes.quote: It's your outlook on life that counts. If you take yourself lightly and don't take yourself too seriously, pretty soon you can find the humor in our everyday lives. And sometimes it can be a lifesaver.
quotes.author: Betty White

quotes.quote: I learned that the problems that we have are not solved by blaming somebody else, and that our hope is not in who governs us as a nation. It's not in Mitt Romney or Barack Obama or Ron Paul. Our hope is in the power of God and his gospel working in the hearts of people.
quotes.author: Kirk Cameron

quotes.quote: It's tragic from how far we've come from 'Hope and Change'.
quotes.author: Ted Cruz

quotes.quote: Only in the darkness can you see the stars.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quotes.quote: Right now I'm not involved with anybody, but I hope by 75 I will be again.
quotes.author: Stevie Nicks

quotes.quote: I hope that people will see that we don't have to sit by the sidelines and watch as the two major parties limit their choices to slightly different flavors of the status quo. It is, in fact, possible to join the fray, stand up for principles and offer a real alternative.
quotes.author: Gary Johnson

quotes.quote: Protest and anger practically always derives from hope, and the shouting out against injustice is always in the hope of those injustices being somewhat corrected and a little more justice established.
quotes.author: John Berger

quotes.quote: Your destiny is to fulfill those things upon which you focus most intently. So choose to keep your focus on that which is truly magnificent, beautiful, uplifting and joyful. Your life is always moving toward something.
quotes.author: Ralph Marston

quotes.quote: I think the most important thing is to keep active and to hope that your mind stays active.
quotes.author: Jane Goodall

quotes.quote: Hope never abandons you, you abandon it.
quotes.author: George Weinberg

quotes.quote: I just hope people see that if God can do something beautiful with my broken pieces, then God truly has a plan for each and everyone of us.
quotes.author: Nick Vujicic

quotes.quote: I would hope that understanding and reconciliation are not limited to the 19th hole alone.
quotes.author: Gerald R. Ford

quotes.quote: Even a purely moral act that has no hope of any immediate and visible political effect can gradually and indirectly, over time, gain in political significance.
quotes.author: Vaclav Havel

quotes.quote: In some ways, Israel has achieved a peace. There are fewer rockets being sent into Sderot, there are no rockets to speak of from the North, there has been very little terrorism from the West Bank. It's a kind of peace. I hope for a better and more enduring peace. Peace is not an endgame; we will never be completely at peace.
quotes.author: Alan Dershowitz

quotes.quote: I have hope in people, in individuals. Because you don't know what's going to rise from the ruins.
quotes.author: Joan Baez

quotes.quote: I tend to think the world is a bit of a miserable place, so anyone who can add to people's optimistic, cheerful side is doing a good job, which is what I hope I'm doing.
quotes.author: Jo Brand

quotes.quote: We are now on the threshold of a newer movement, with a newer hope and a new inspiration.
quotes.author: James Larkin

quotes.quote: I hope I die before I get old.
quotes.author: Roger Daltrey

quotes.quote: I've done it all. I'm thankful and proud of what I've accomplished in my life. I hope to keep doing it.
quotes.author: Ralph Stanley

quotes.quote: I hope to use dialogue and culture as a means of bringing people of various cultures together, and using that as a way to resolve conflict.
quotes.author: Herbie Hancock

quotes.quote: You get these moments in the ring that live forever. That's what Muhammad Ali accomplished, and I hope that I have, too.
quotes.author: Sugar Ray Leonard

quotes.quote: My main hope for myself is to be where I am.
quotes.author: Woody Harrelson

quotes.quote: Most people like to read about intrigue and spies. I hope to provide a metaphor for the average reader's daily life. Most of us live in a slightly conspiratorial relationship with our employer and perhaps with our marriage.
quotes.author: John le Carre

quotes.quote: I hope this will help new moms not feel alone or desperate, and that there is no shame in their feelings. PPD is out of their control, but the treatment and healing process is not.
quotes.author: Brooke Shields

quotes.quote: We have a hope of succeeding if we learn from our past mistakes and pull together to make the hard choices.
quotes.author: Carl Levin

quotes.quote: The things you do for yourself are gone when you are gone, but the things you do for others remain as your legacy.
quotes.author: Kalu Ndukwe Kalu

quotes.quote: We all know about love, faith, sadness, despair, hope, hopelessness, longing, desire... those are things we all have inside of us, and that's what my songs are about... what it means to be a human being.
quotes.author: Ron Pope

quotes.quote: Whatever I do, I hope it's quality, I hope it's something that's class.
quotes.author: Garth Brooks

quotes.quote: I was born in 1949, and by the time I was 10, I figured out that my hope chest was not aimed in the same direction everybody else's was. And that life was going to be very, very complicated. And that I could either be provocative and declamatory, or shy, retiring and scared.
quotes.author: Dorothy Allison

quotes.quote: I hope for peace and sanity - it's the same thing.
quotes.author: Studs Terkel

quotes.quote: It is above all by the imagination that we achieve perception and compassion and hope.
quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quotes.quote: And if there's any hope for America, it lies in a revolution, and if there's any hope for a revolution in America, it lies in getting Elvis Presley to become Che Guevara.
quotes.author: Phil Ochs

quotes.quote: My hope is that people will be repulsed by the character's complete lack of ethics and obsession with consumerism - that's what I was saying about the difference between the character's message and the film's message.
quotes.author: Christian Bale

quotes.quote: You know how I came up with the name 'Road to the Super Bowl?' It's an homage to the old Bob Hope - Bing Crosby buddy movies - you know, like 'Road to Zanzibar' or 'Road to Morocco.' Can you tell? All I've done my whole life is go to movies.
quotes.author: Steve Sabol

quotes.quote: HopeSmiles from the threshold of the year to come, Whispering 'it will be happier'...
quotes.author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

quotes.quote: Those who have no hope pass their old age shrouded with an inward gloom.
quotes.author: Wilfred Owen

quotes.quote: If I write a book where all I've ever experienced is success, people won't take a positive lesson from it. In being candid, I have to own up to my own failures, both in my marriage and in my work environment.
quotes.author: Sonia Sotomayor

quotes.quote: Writing a song is much like being an author. Yes, we all have tools to write (everyone has a brain I hope!), but that doesn't all of a sudden make us best selling authors.
quotes.author: Ken Hill

quotes.quote: I don't know. I have incredible amounts of hope that things can change. It takes people who believe.
quotes.author: Morgan Spurlock

quotes.quote: Once you do away with the idea of people as fixed, static entities, then you see that people can change, and there is hope.
quotes.author: bell hooks

quotes.quote: Throughout the ages, Christians have adapted John of Patmos's visions to changing times, reading their own social, political and religious conflicts into the cosmic war he so powerfully evokes. Yet his Book of Revelation appeals not only to fear and desires for vengeance but also to hope.
quotes.author: Elaine Pagels

quotes.quote: You practice mindfulness, on the one hand, to be calm and peaceful. On the other hand, as you practice mindfulness and live a life of peace, you inspire hope for a future of peace.
quotes.author: Thich Nhat Hanh

quotes.quote: When I see my own people going through the tough times, it's a wake-up call. I hope my influence can impact someone else's decision to get out here and vote.
quotes.author: Bow Wow

quotes.quote: I hope to have communion with the people, that is the most important thing.
quotes.author: Pope John Paul II

quotes.quote: Personally, love is very important for me. There are lots of ordinary things in life, so love should be extraordinary. I hope I achieve that.
quotes.author: Ranbir Kapoor

quotes.quote: Don't compare me to Babe Ruth. God gave me the opportunity and the ability to be here at the right time, at the right moment, just like he gave Babe Ruth when he was playing. I just hope I can keep doing what I've been doing - keep taking care of business.
quotes.author: Sammy Sosa

quotes.quote: A year or so ago I went through all the people in my life and asked myself: does this person inspire me, genuinely love me and support me unconditionally? I wanted nothing but positive influences in my life.
quotes.author: Mena Suvari

quotes.quote: All I can do is leave it in God's hands and hope that my fans feel where I'm coming from.
quotes.author: Aaliyah

quotes.quote: The comfortable estate of widowhood is the only hope that keeps up a wife's spirits.
quotes.author: John Gay

quotes.quote: I hope that tomorrow we can all, wherever we are, join in expressing our grief at Diana's loss, and gratitude for her all-too-short life. It is a chance to show to the whole world the British nation united in grief and respect.
quotes.author: Queen Elizabeth II

quotes.quote: However spontaneous I hope a photograph will look, I always put a lot of thought into how I can make it happen. The very best pictures are the most relaxed, so a lot of fussing around technically can completely break the spell, and everyone freezes up with nerves.
quotes.author: Mario Testino

quotes.quote: Everybody's got something. In the end, what choice does one really have but to understand that truth, to really take it in, and then shop for groceries, get a haircut, do one's work; get on with the business of one's life. That's the hope, anyway.
quotes.author: David Rakoff

quotes.quote: What is true of the individual will be tomorrow true of the whole nation if individuals will but refuse to lose heart and hope.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Poets have said that the reason to have children is to give yourself immortality. Immortality? Now that I have five children, my only hope is that they are all out of the house before I die.
quotes.author: Bill Cosby

quotes.quote: To hope means to be ready at every moment for that which is not yet born, and yet not become desperate if there is no birth in our lifetime.
quotes.author: Erich Fromm

quotes.quote: The very least you can do in your life is figure out what you hope for. And the most you can do is live inside that hope. Not admire it from a distance but live right in it, under its roof.
quotes.author: Barbara Kingsolver,  Animal Dreams

quotes.quote: Pessimists are the people who have no hope for themselves or for others. Pessimists are also people who think the human race is beneath their notice, that they're better than other human beings.
quotes.author: James A. Baldwin

quotes.quote: My philosophy in life is, Decide what you want to do. You have to have something to hope for.
quotes.author: Lou Holtz

quotes.quote: When things are bad, we take comfort in the thought that they could always get worse. And when they are, we find hope in the thought that things are so bad they have to get better.
quotes.author: Malcolm Forbes

quotes.quote: My hope is that people begin to understand what the fiscal realities are - how economic virtue differs from political virtue - and develop a realization of their individual economic philosophy in comparison to their perceived political ideology.
quotes.author: Kurt Bills

quotes.quote: The people of Liberia know what it means to be deprived of clean water, but we also know what it means to see our children to begin to smile again with a restoration of hope and faith in the future.
quotes.author: Ellen Johnson Sirleaf

quotes.quote: 'You are no saint,' says the devil. Well, if I am not, I am a sinner, and Jesus Christ came into the world to save sinners. Sink or swim, I go to Him; other hope, I have none.
quotes.author: Charles Spurgeon

quotes.quote: Hope is the cordial that keeps life from stagnating.
quotes.author: Samuel Richardson

quotes.quote: When you deprive people of their right to live in dignity, to hope for a better future, to have control over their lives, when you deprive them of that choice, then you expect them to fight for these rights.
quotes.author: Queen Rania of Jordan

quotes.quote: A citizen is a political and moral agent who in fact has a shared sense of hope and responsibility to others and not just to him or herself.
quotes.author: Henry Giroux

quotes.quote: My hope is that countries like Morocco will have investment to create work, so people don't have to leave.
quotes.author: Tahar Ben Jelloun

quotes.quote: The United States is the world's best hope, but if you fetter her in the interests and quarrels of other nations, if you tangle her in the intrigues of Europe, you will destroy her power for good and endanger her very existence.
quotes.author: Henry Cabot Lodge

quotes.quote: The truth about filmmaking is you have all these ideas and you're trying to convince everybody that they should buy into this idea, but at two o'clock in the morning when you're all on your own you're going, 'Geez, I hope I know what I'm doing. I hope this idea is gonna work.'
quotes.author: Gavid Hood

quotes.quote: Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo,  Les MisÃ©rables

quotes.quote: To cherish what remains of the Earth and to foster its renewal is our only legitimate hope of survival.
quotes.author: Wendell Berry

quotes.quote: We hope the world will act in the spirit of enlightened self-interest.
quotes.author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee

quotes.quote: You might find me outside with a can of hair spray, spraying it with the hope that the sun will burn a hole in the Earth. Another part of me hopes people will grow up and evolve and get smarter. That's the paradox of Marilyn Manson.
quotes.author: Marilyn Manson

quotes.quote: The simplistic solutions of Deepak Chopra cannot stand against the lofty and deep teachings of Jesus Christ. Only in His answers will we find the ultimate hope for the human heart.
quotes.author: Ravi Zacharias

quotes.quote: The poor prey on one another because their lives offer no hope and communicate the tragic message to these human beings that they have no possibility to attain a decent standard of living.
quotes.author: Thabo Mbeki

quotes.quote: Hope is the motivation that empowers the unemployed, enabling them to get out of bed every single morning with unbounded enthusiasm as they look for work.
quotes.author: Emanuel Cleaver

quotes.quote: My hopes are not always realized, but I always hope.
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.quote: A propensity to hope and joy is real riches; one to fear and sorrow real poverty.
quotes.author: David Hume

quotes.quote: My hope is that I will take the good from my experiences and extrapolate them further into areas with which I am unfamiliar. I simply do not know exactly what that difference will be in my judging. But I accept there will be some based on my gender and my Latina heritage.
quotes.author: Sonia Sotomayor

quotes.quote: Insecurity and resignation mingle with the hope for a better order.
quotes.author: Gustav Heinemann

quotes.quote: Among the many signs of a lively faith and hope we have in eternal life, one of the surest is not being overly sad at the death of those whom we dearly love in our Lord.
quotes.author: Saint Ignatius

quotes.quote: Let hope inspire you, but let not idealism blind you. Don't look back, you can never look back.
quotes.author: Don Henley

quotes.quote: When I was a kid, my father didn't really have much hope for me. He thought I was a dreamer; he didn't think I would amount to anything. My mother also.
quotes.author: Frank Gehry

quotes.quote: Even if I don't always behave as I should, this still doesn't explain why so many people have something against me. But you know how it is. A lot of people vent themselves by coming to the stadium to yell at me. I hope it's not racism. I tell myself that it's not racism; it's because I'm tough, and I repeat this to myself.
quotes.author: Mario Balotelli

quotes.quote: I've flown across America, I've scaled fences, I've stood under windows and gone out of my way hundreds of times. I'm a hopeless romantic. There's no hope for me.
quotes.author: Joel Madden

quotes.quote: On the morning of Thanksgiving, I would wake up to the home smelling of all good things, wafting upstairs to my room. I would set the table with the fancy silverware and china and hope that my parents and grandmother wouldn't have the annual Thanksgiving fight about Richard Nixon.
quotes.author: Debi Mazar

quotes.quote: The world helps you to keep evolving and hope it's for better. You have to rise above all the tragedies in life. You have to grow, and if you stop growing, you are old.
quotes.author: Hrithik Roshan

quotes.quote: I'll always stay connected with Apple. I hope that throughout my life I'll sort of have the thread of my life and the thread of Apple weave in and out of each other, like a tapestry. There may be a few years when I'm not there, but I'll always come back.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: I hope that my story, I hope that my life is... an encouragement for people, especially in Brooklyn. I feel humbled and blessed.
quotes.author: Iyanla Vanzant

quotes.quote: Successful people maintain a positive focus in life no matter what is going on around them. They stay focused on their past successes rather than their past failures, and on the next action steps they need to take to get them closer to the fulfillment of their goals rather than all the other distractions that life presents to them.
quotes.author: Jack Canfield

quotes.quote: I don't feel a lack of hope. It's just disappointment that after all these years we're still fighting meaningless wars for a handful of people.
quotes.author: Geezer Butler

quotes.quote: I have cherished the ideal of a democratic and free society in which all persons live together in harmony and with equal opportunities. It is an ideal which I hope to live for and to achieve. But if needs be, it is an ideal for which I am prepared to die.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.quote: One of the greatest gifts we can give people is the hope that their death is nothing to fear - you know, not that it has no fear in it, but the promise of scripture is that God will lead us through the valley of the shadow of death.
quotes.author: Max Lucado

quotes.quote: Maybe everyone can live beyond what they're capable of.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  I Am the Messenger

quotes.quote: Selfishness must always be forgiven you know, because there is no hope of a cure.
quotes.author: Jane Austen

quotes.quote: Well, you know, in any novel you would hope that the hero has someone to push back against, and villains - I find the most interesting villains those who do the right things for the wrong reasons, or the wrong things for the right reasons. Either one is interesting. I love the gray area between right and wrong.
quotes.author: Dan Brown

quotes.quote: Being a mom is what life is about. I hope people realize what the priorities in life should be and know not everything has to be perfect.
quotes.author: Kourtney Kardashian

quotes.quote: Only those with skin as thick as elephant hide can hope to sail through their teens unscathed by self-doubt and bouts of depression.
quotes.author: Mariella Frostrup

quotes.quote: You can't go around hoping that most people have sterling moral characters. The most you can hope for is that people will pretend that they do.
quotes.author: Fran Lebowitz

quotes.quote: We are all serving a life sentence, and good behavior is our only hope for a pardon.
quotes.author: Douglas Horton

quotes.quote: Pregnancy is something that I always love. It's about hope and the future and a new baby.
quotes.author: Carine Roitfeld

quotes.quote: I never read the life of any important person without discovering that he knew more and could do more than I could ever hope to know or do in half a dozen lifetimes.
quotes.author: J. B. Priestley

quotes.quote: Our only real hope for democracy is that we get the money out of politics entirely and establish a system of publicly funded elections.
quotes.author: Noam Chomsky

quotes.quote: I just felt it was my job to show that there is no easy way to success, and that anyone who gets even just one Top 40 hit deserves their moment in the sun. I accentuate the positive and eliminate the negative. That is the timeless thing.
quotes.author: Casey Kasem

quotes.quote: When one takes action for others, one's own suffering is transformed into the energy that can keep one moving forward; a light of hope illuminating a new tomorrow for oneself and others is kindled.
quotes.author: Daisaku Ikeda

quotes.quote: Whiskey's to tough, Champagne costs too much, Vodka puts my mouth in gear. I hope this refrain, Will help me explain, As a matter of fact, I like beer.
quotes.author: Tom T. Hall

quotes.quote: Democracy is a daring concept - a hope that we'll be best governed if all of us participate in the act of government. It is meant to be a conversation, a place where the intelligence and local knowledge of the electorate sums together to arrive at actions that reflect the participation of the largest possible number of people.
quotes.author: Brian Eno

quotes.quote: Did I offer peace today? Did I bring a smile to someone's face? Did I say words of healing? Did I let go of my anger and resentment? Did I forgive? Did I love? These are the real questions. I must trust that the little bit of love that I sow now will bear many fruits, here in this world and the life to come.
quotes.author: Henri Nouwen

quotes.quote: Most of me was glad when my mother died. She was a handful, but not in a cute, festive way. More in a life-threatening way, that had caused me a long time ago to give up all hope of ever feeling good about having had her as a mother.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: Hope is in the name of God, the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Hope is when you compare your suffering to the infinite, immeasurable love and grace of God.
quotes.author: Nick Vujicic

quotes.quote: If you don't like me, life goes on, you know what I mean? But I hope you do like me. Because I think that in addition to being pushy, I'm nice.
quotes.author: Christine Quinn

quotes.quote: So many times I've photographed stories that show the degradation of the planet. I had one idea to go and photograph the factories that were polluting, and to see all the deposits of garbage. But, in the end, I thought the only way to give us an incentive, to bring hope, is to show the pictures of the pristine planet - to see the innocence.
quotes.author: Sebastiao Salgado

quotes.quote: I was close to getting married a long time ago. But it didn't happen, and since then it has not been happening. It is jinxed, and I am very happy. I hope this jinx continues.
quotes.author: Salman Khan

quotes.quote: Part of me really wants to believe that hope is entirely available to all of us. We don't have to embrace it. It would be sentimental and silly to say that we all need it, but it is absolutely available to all of us.
quotes.author: Colum McCann

quotes.quote: When I see myself on film it makes me smile, I mean making a good living doing what I enjoy is soo much fun. I just hope that everyone has the chance to enjoy life like I do.
quotes.author: Adrienne Barbeau

quotes.quote: We write in ways that, we generally hope, reflect real life, or at least look familiar to humans. And in life, recurring themes are a recurring theme. We never quite conquer a pet vice or a relationship pattern or a communication habit. We're haunted by our particular demons.
quotes.author: Sara Zarr

quotes.quote: We tell them that we believe it will be beautiful because that is our specialty, we only create joy and beauty. We have never done a sad work. Through the drawings, we hope a majority will be able to visualize it.
quotes.author: Christo

quotes.quote: When I talk to people in need, they tell me they want to hope; they are eager for opportunity; they are ready for better days. And I can tell you that every time their hopes are disappointed, all nations lose.
quotes.author: Abdallah II of Jordan

quotes.quote: In a time of destruction, create something.
quotes.author: Maxine Hong Kingston

quotes.quote: It is in vain to hope to please all alike. Let a man stand with his face in what direction he will, he must necessarily turn his back on one half of the world.
quotes.author: George Dennison Prentice

quotes.quote: Education exposes young people to a broader world, a world full of opportunity and hope.
quotes.author: Christine Gregoire

quotes.quote: Religion is a complex and often contradictory force in our world. It fosters hope and comfort but also doubt and guilt. It creates both community and exclusion. It brings societies together around shared belief and tears them apart through war. However, what unites the faithful, whatever their religion, is the unshakeable force of generosity.
quotes.author: Laura Arrillaga-Andreessen

quotes.quote: It is sound judgment to hope that in the not too distant future we shall be competent to understand so simple a thing as a star.
quotes.author: Arthur Eddington

quotes.quote: It's amazing how a little tomorrow can make up for a whole lot of yesterday.
quotes.author: John Guare,  Landscape of the Body

quotes.quote: I hope the wonder of what happens to my characters never goes away. That yearning keeps me writing.
quotes.author: Kimberly Willis Holt

quotes.quote: Tears shed for another person are not a sign of weakness. They are a sign of a pure heart.
quotes.author: JosÃ© N. Harris,  MI VIDA: A Story of Faith, Hope and Love

quotes.quote: My songs have always had hope and perseverance in them - I never write songs that have no escape hatch, no positivity.
quotes.author: Jakob Dylan

quotes.quote: For the last 30 years our cinemas have been ruled by science fiction and horror. We've had some very good Fantasy films in that time period, but for my tastes I still haven't seen fantasy done to absolute perfection. That is the hope I have in this project.
quotes.author: Harry Knowles

quotes.quote: I stand firm behind the belief that, for me, songwriting isn't something that I do or command, it happens to me. I can either choose to stop and acknowledge it, or put it off and hope that it won't fade away. 'That Wasn't Me' is no exception - it came together more quickly than any other song I have ever constructed on my own.
quotes.author: Brandi Carlile

quotes.quote: America stands as a beacon of hope and the possibility of a better life - but it is also a nation where nearly 1 in 4 children live in poverty.
quotes.author: Chris Van Hollen

quotes.quote: I think that everybody needs four things in life. Everybody needs something to do regardless of age. Everybody needs someone to love. Everybody needs something to hope for, and, of course, everybody needs someone to believe in.
quotes.author: Lou Holtz

quotes.quote: The hope of eternal life is not to be taken up upon slight grounds. It is a subject to be settled between God and your own soul; settled for eternity. A supposed hope, and nothing more, will prove your ruin.
quotes.author: Ellen G. White

quotes.quote: A radical inner transformation and rise to a new level of consciousness might be the only real hope we have in the current global crisis brought on by the dominance of the Western mechanistic paradigm.
quotes.author: Stanislav Grof

quotes.quote: I think it's a mistake to ever look for hope outside of one's self.
quotes.author: Arthur Miller

quotes.quote: Believe that life is worth living and your belief will help create the fact.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.quote: There will always be a place for us somewhere, somehow, as long as we see to it that working people fight for everything they have, everything they hope to get, for dignity, equality, democracy, to oppose war and to bring to the world a better life.
quotes.author: Harry Bridges

quotes.quote: Live life to the fullest, and focus on the positive.
quotes.author: Matt Cameron

quotes.quote: I hope we will not so characterize religious people as being so narrow and so biased towards people not of their own religion that they cannot even work with them in this common cause to which you say they are committed.
quotes.author: Barney Frank

quotes.quote: 'Peace Train' is a song I wrote, the message of which continues to breeze thunderously through the hearts of millions. There is a powerful need for people to feel that gust of hope rise up again.
quotes.author: Cat Stevens

quotes.quote: I would hope my legacy would be bringing smiles to faces. Happiness with my music.
quotes.author: Janet Jackson

quotes.quote: All what we hope for is that a day will come, when we have all gone, when people will say that this man has tried, and his family tried. This is all there is to seek in this world.
quotes.author: King Hussein I

quotes.quote: I hope I look skinnier in 3D. I hope I don't look three times as fat. That'll be disappointing.
quotes.author: Kathy Bates

quotes.quote: Dwell on the beauty of life. Watch the stars, and see yourself running with them.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

quotes.quote: Many believe - and I believe - that I have been designated for this work by God. In spite of my old age, I do not want to give it up; I work out of love for God and I put all my hope in Him.
quotes.author: Michelangelo

quotes.quote: What day is it?"It's today,"squeaked Piglet.My favorite day,"said Pooh.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne

quotes.quote: A man must love a thing very much if he not only practices it without any hope of fame and money, but even... without any hope of doing it well.
quotes.author: Oliver Herford

quotes.quote: Bottom up thinkers try to start from experience and move from experience to understanding. They don't start with certain general principles they think beforehand are likely to be true; they just hope to find out what reality is like.
quotes.author: John Polkinghorne

quotes.quote: When you have lost hope, you have lost everything. And when you think all is lost, when all is dire and bleak, there is always hope.
quotes.author: Pittacus Lore,  I Am Number Four

quotes.quote: He who despairs of the human condition is a coward, but he who has hope for it is a fool.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: As for gun control advocates, I have no hope whatever that any facts whatever will make the slightest dent in their thinking - or lack of thinking.
quotes.author: Thomas Sowell

quotes.quote: A mission is a place where you ask nonbelievers to come and find faith and hope and feel love.
quotes.author: Robert H. Schuller

quotes.quote: Strange as it may seem, I still hope for the best, even though the best, like an interesting piece of mail, so rarely arrives, and even when it does it can be lost so easily.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket,  The Beatrice Letters

quotes.quote: If the United Nations once admits that international disputes can be settled by using force, then we will have destroyed the foundation of the organization and our best hope of establishing a world order.
quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

quotes.quote: We dream to give ourselves hope. To stop dreaming - well, that's like saying you can never change your fate.
quotes.author: Amy Tan,  The Hundred Secret Senses

quotes.quote: Children are God's Apostles, sent forth, day by day, to preach of love, and hope, and peace.
quotes.author: James Russell Lowell

quotes.quote: All the interests of my reason, speculative as well as practical, combine in the three following questions: 1. What can I know? 2. What ought I to do? 3. What may I hope?
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.quote: You cannot hope to sweep someone else away by the force of your writing until it has been done to you.
quotes.author: Stephen King

quotes.quote: Not without hope we suffer and we mourn.
quotes.author: William Wordsworth

quotes.quote: The care of the Earth is our most ancient and most worthy, and after all our most pleasing responsibility. To cherish what remains of it and to foster its renewal is our only hope.
quotes.author: Wendell Berry

quotes.quote: My goal is to be the best quarterback I can be for the Colts, and hope that it's good enough.
quotes.author: Andrew Luck

quotes.quote: This is where it all begins. Everything starts here, today.
quotes.author: David Nicholls,  One Day

quotes.quote: It's going to be all right, sir,"Harry said over and over again, more worried by Dumbledore's silence than he had been by his weakened voice. "We're nearly there ... I can Apparate us both back ... don't worry ...""I am not worried, Harry,"said Dumbledore, his voice a little stronger despite the freezing water. "I am with you.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

quotes.quote: Many possessions, if they do not make a man better, are at least expected to make his children happier; and this pathetic hope is behind many exertions.
quotes.author: George Santayana

quotes.quote: You can cut all the flowers but you cannot keep Spring from coming.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda

quotes.quote: Having a sense of purpose is having a sense of self. A course to plot is a destination to hope for.
quotes.author: Bryant H. McGill

quotes.quote: Even when we make mistakes, we hope others will love us in spite of our shortcomings - even if we don't deserve it.
quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin

quotes.quote: For many people, myself included, the end of the world is happening all the time! It is a form of criticality that paradoxically gives us hope for change and improvement.
quotes.author: Douglas Coupland

quotes.quote: Just as a mother finds pleasure in taking her little child on her lap, there to feed and caress him, in like manner our loving God shows His fondness for His beloved souls who have given themselves entirely to Him and have placed all their hope in His goodness.
quotes.author: Alphonsus Liguori

quotes.quote: Don't fall in love with your wit. Your cleverly turned phrase may not, as you hope, show off how much gray matter you have, especially if the phrase is at someone else's expense.
quotes.author: Harvey Mackay

quotes.quote: Hope can be a powerful force. Maybe there's no actual magic in it, but when you know what you hope for most and hold it like a light within you, you can make things happen, almost like magic.
quotes.author: Laini Taylor,  Daughter of Smoke & Bone

quotes.quote: Hope is the struggle of the soul, breaking loose from what is perishable, and attesting her eternity.
quotes.author: Herman Melville

quotes.quote: We hope that, when the insects take over the world, they will remember with gratitude how we took them along on all our picnics.
quotes.author: Bill Vaughan

quotes.quote: We are biological creatures. We are born, we live, we die. There is no transcendent purpose to existence. At best we are creatures of reason, and by using reason we can cure ourselves of emotional excess. Purged of both hope and fear, we find courage in the face of helplessness, insignificance and uncertainty.
quotes.author: Jonathan Sacks

quotes.quote: I hope that one day when I'll go back to Pakistan, I will build a university like Harvard.
quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai

quotes.quote: We have been given God in our souls and Christ in our flesh. We have the power to believe where others deny, to hope where others despair, to love where others hurt.
quotes.author: Brennan Manning

quotes.quote: Pity the selfishness of lovers: it is brief, a forlorn hope; it is impossible.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Bowen

quotes.quote: I hope I go to Heaven, and when I do, I'm going to do what every San Franciscan does when he gets there. He looks around and says, 'It ain't bad, but it ain't San Francisco.'
quotes.author: Herb Caen

quotes.quote: Our only hope is to control the vote.
quotes.author: Medgar Evers

quotes.quote: Until women themselves reject stigma and refuse to feel shame for the way others treat them, they have no hope of achieving full human stature.
quotes.author: Germaine Greer

quotes.quote: It is often in the darkest skies that we see the brightest stars.
quotes.author: Richard Evans

quotes.quote: I don't think of all the misery, but of the beauty that still remains.
quotes.author: Anne Frank,  The Diary of a Young Girl

quotes.quote: It is practically impossible to teach good programming to students that have had a prior exposure to BASIC: as potential programmers they are mentally mutilated beyond hope of regeneration.
quotes.author: Edsger Dijkstra

quotes.quote: Compromise is but the sacrifice of one right or good in the hope of retaining another - too often ending in the loss of both.
quotes.author: Tryon Edwards

quotes.quote: There are a lot of times that we feel like our hands are tied - 'I have no control over if I'm going to lose my job.' 'I have no control over if I'm going to be able to pay my bills.' You've got to realize that that's where your trust comes in. You have to trust God, and keep your hope, because your hope is what produces your faith.
quotes.author: Victoria Osteen

quotes.quote: I've seen the ticket, and I still can't believe it. When I see the money, I hope I don't hit the floor.
quotes.author: Judy Garland

quotes.quote: We are constituted so that simple acts of kindness, such as giving to charity or expressing gratitude, have a positive effect on our long-term moods. The key to the happy life, it seems, is the good life: a life with sustained relationships, challenging work, and connections to community.
quotes.author: Paul Bloom

quotes.quote: One of the greatest delusions in the world is the hope that the evils in this world are to be cured by legislation.
quotes.author: Thomas Reed

quotes.quote: Man often becomes what he believes himself to be. If I keep on saying to myself that I cannot do a certain thing, it is possible that I may end by really becoming incapable of doing it. On the contrary, if I have the belief that I can do it, I shall surely acquire the capacity to do it even if I may not have it at the beginning.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Life goes on, and I'm moving on to the next thing, but I hope the soaps that are still running will thrive. They have millions of loyal viewers.
quotes.author: Susan Lucci

quotes.quote: Well I certainly have learned and I hope I'm moving on and certainly two years of prison was a terrible punishment.
quotes.author: Jeffrey Archer

quotes.quote: I hope we're all kind of influencing each other now to keep the quality up on those things. They seem to be getting better and better and better as there's not only sort of a film geek audience, there's also a general interest in the overall film consuming population.
quotes.author: Jay Roach

quotes.quote: When I was working at the Sprint store, I got laid off. I was bummed out, but I stayed positive. I used the money I had earned while working there to make my first album. Without that job, maybe 'Corazon Sin Cara' would never had been made. It's a very inspirational story.
quotes.author: Prince Royce

quotes.quote: Creativity comes from trust. Trust your instincts. And never hope more than you work.
quotes.author: Rita Mae Brown

quotes.quote: Survival was my only hope, success my only revenge.
quotes.author: Patricia Cornwell

quotes.quote: Any institution faces two basic choices if they hope to spark new ideas. One is to leverage the brains trust within their organization by creating a special event dedicated to new thinking. The other is to look outside themselves to stimulate solutions.
quotes.author: Simon Mainwaring

quotes.quote: Some people think I'm a total moron and I would hope most people think I'm very good at what I do.
quotes.author: Dan Abrams

quotes.quote: For a long time, music was hope. Now it seems music isn't enough to make me happy. It used to be that's all I needed to keep going. Now I need other things to take up the other parts of my life.
quotes.author: Juliana Hatfield

quotes.quote: The optimist proclaims that we live in the best of all possible worlds; and the pessimist fears this is true.
quotes.author: James Branch Cabell,  The Silver Stallion

quotes.quote: If you live through the initial stage of fame and get past it, and remember thats not who you are. If you live past that, then you have a hope of maybe learning how to spell the word artist.
quotes.author: Patrick Swayze

quotes.quote: You know, this is a war of ideology, a war of thoughts and of faith. And we need people to really stand for faith and trust, not hope and change.
quotes.author: Sharron Angle

quotes.quote: There is a saying in Tibetan, 'Tragedy should be utilized as a source of strength.'No matter what sort of difficulties, how painful experience is, if we lose our hope, that's our real disaster.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV

quotes.quote: Charge forward with hope and get the best medical advice you can. Talk to your friends, neighbors, family, and together you attack it. We can't always control what happens to us, but we can always control how we react to it.
quotes.author: Robert Urich

quotes.quote: I just consider myself a piece of the puzzle and I'm lucky enough to be asked or invited to the party, if you will. I hope I can bring some laughs and grimaces to the fans.
quotes.author: Adam Baldwin

quotes.quote: America is hope. It is compassion. It is excellence. It is valor.
quotes.author: Paul Tsongas

quotes.quote: I think I've lived a pretty hard life. What I mean by hard is that... I've been kind of reckless with things. I'm a passionate person. I'm a super passionate person. I think there's definitely been sorrow in my life, good and bad. I think it comes through. I hope it comes through in my writing because to me that's what artistry is.
quotes.author: Kip Moore

quotes.quote: The secular world looks to the church and to its chagrin, finds no love, no life, no laughter, no hope and no happiness.
quotes.author: Rod Parsley

quotes.quote: I've learnt that through life you just get on with it. You're going to meet a lot of dishonest people along the line and you say good luck to them. I hope they live in comfort. Then I start sticking more pins in their effigies.
quotes.author: Roger Moore

quotes.quote: I discovered that in a story I could safely dream any dream, hope any hope, go anywhere I pleased any time I pleased, fight any foe, win or lose, live or die. My stories created a safe experimental learning place.
quotes.author: Donald Davis

quotes.quote: Tragedy is restful: and the reason is that hope, that foul, deceitful thing, has no part in it.
quotes.author: Jean Anouilh

quotes.quote: I had a huge advantage when I started 50 years ago - my job was secure. I didn't have to promote myself. These days there's far more pressure to make a mark, so the temptation is to make adventure television or personality shows. I hope the more didactic approach won't be lost.
quotes.author: David Attenborough

quotes.quote: The other day I got a text from a boy, but it wasn't hot. I mean, if you're going to text me every day, you haven't seen me for months and you're trying to seduce me, you'd better spice up that text and make it more exciting than 'How was your day? I hope you're having a beautiful one.' Sadly, I haven't been doing a lot of kissing lately.
quotes.author: Chloe Sevigny

quotes.quote: If I'm the people's poet, then I ought to be in people's hands - and, I hope, in their heart.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: Although finding fruit flies in your wine or beer can be a bit annoying, I hope people will pause to admire the tenacity of these clever little creatures. They are really just hungry animals looking for something to eat, and have no intention of ruining your happy hour.
quotes.author: Michael Dickinson

quotes.quote: What we hope ever to do with ease, we must learn first to do with diligence.
quotes.author: Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: I hope that no more groans of wounded men and women will ever go to the ear of the Great Spirit Chief above, and that all people may be one people.
quotes.author: Chief Joseph

quotes.quote: I hope you will go out and let stories happen to you, and that you will work them, water them with your blood and tears and you laughter till they bloom, till you yourself burst into bloom.
quotes.author: Clarissa Pinkola Estes

quotes.quote: The very least you can do in your life is to figure out what you hope for. And the most you can do is live inside that hope. Not admire it from a distance but live right in it, under its roof.
quotes.author: Barbara Kingsolver

quotes.quote: I don't remember deciding to become a writer. You decide to become a dentist or a postman. For me, writing is like being gay. You finally admit that this is who you are, you come out and hope that no one runs away.
quotes.author: Mark Haddon

quotes.quote: These wars appear also to have given its death blow to colonialism and to imperialism in its colonial form, under which weaker peoples were treated as possessions to be economically exploited. At least we hope that such colonialism is on the way out.
quotes.author: Emily Greene Balch

quotes.quote: You've gotta dive into the abyss if you wanna get anything good. Every record, you've gotta go down in the abyss and hope that you come out of it alive.
quotes.author: King Tuff

quotes.quote: I meet people in my daily life, people who seem to experience some change and some growth on a personal level, and that gives me hope.
quotes.author: Tracy Chapman

quotes.quote: The best way to not feel hopeless is to get up and do something. Don't wait for good things to happen to you. If you go out and make some good things happen, you will fill the world with hope, you will fill yourself with hope.
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: There is no despair so absolute as that which comes with the first moments of our first great sorrow, when we have not yet known what it is to have suffered and be healed, to have despaired and have recovered hope.
quotes.author: George Eliot

quotes.quote: There is a crack in everything.That's how the light gets in.
quotes.author: Leonard Cohen,  Selected Poems, 1956-1968

quotes.quote: Logic is one thing, the human animal another. You can quite easily propose a logical solution to something and at the same time hope in your heart of hearts it won't work out.
quotes.author: Luigi Pirandello

quotes.quote: My mum thought my TV and film addiction was laziness. If you're an immigrant, you know you'll never be an accepted part of society, but you hope your children will be, and you try to make them essential to the community in a practical way - being a doctor or a lawyer. Acting was beyond their comprehension.
quotes.author: Sanjeev Bhaskar

quotes.quote: When it was dark, you always carried the sun in your hand for me.
quotes.author: SeÃ¡n O'Casey,  Three More Plays: The Silver Tassie, Purple Dust, Red Roses For Me

quotes.quote: Hope is some extraordinary spiritual grace that God gives us to control our fears, not to oust them.
quotes.author: Vincent McNabb

quotes.quote: I hope I have helped to raise the profile of science and to show that physics is not a mystery but can be understood by ordinary people.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: If you keep thinking about what you want to do or what you hope will happen, you don't do it, and it won't happen.
quotes.author: Desiderius Erasmus

quotes.quote: As long as there was coffee in the world, how bad could things be?
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: One of the most difficult things everyone has to learn is that for your entire life you must keep fighting and adjusting if you hope to survive. No matter who you are or what your position is you must keep fighting for whatever it is you desire to achieve.
quotes.author: George Allen, Sr.

quotes.quote: The power of pop culture stories should not be underestimated, and there is an enormous potential for inspirational stories that can have a positive, transformative effect on our lives.
quotes.author: Anita Sarkeesian

quotes.quote: Hope founded upon a human being, a man-made philosophy or any institution is always misplaced... because these things are unreliable and fleeting.
quotes.author: Charles Stanley

quotes.quote: I am not the same man I was 35 years ago. And I hope that five years and ten years from now, I'll be a better man, a more mature man, a wiser man, a more humble man and a more spirited man to serve the good of my people and the good of humanity.
quotes.author: Louis Farrakhan

quotes.quote: Write it on your heart that every day is the best day in the year.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: We can complain because rose bushes have thorns, or rejoice because thorn bushes have roses.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Hope is a necessity for normal life and the major weapon against the suicide impulse.
quotes.author: Karl A. Menninger

quotes.quote: When you are kind to someone in trouble, you hope they'll remember and be kind to someone else. And it'll become like a wildfire.
quotes.author: Whoopi Goldberg

quotes.quote: I have a 6-year-old niece who doesn't look like the majority of girls on the covers of magazines. I hope that by the time she's 16, the world will have changed.
quotes.author: Prabal Gurung

quotes.quote: Marriage is like putting your hand into a bag of snakes in the hope of pulling out an eel.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.quote: Solitude is not something you must hope for in the future. Rather, it is a deepening of the present, and unless you look for it in the present you will never find it.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.quote: The most effective leaders are actually better at guarding against danger when they acknowledge it that it exists. Cowards, in contrast, cling to the hope that failure will never happen and may be sloppy in the face of danger - not because they don't acknowledge that it exists, but because they are just too afraid of it to look it in the eye.
quotes.author: Simon Sinek

quotes.quote: Stalinism is linked with a cult of personality and massive violations of the law, with repression and camps. There is nothing like that in Russia and, I hope, will never again be.
quotes.author: Vladimir Putin

quotes.quote: My No. 1 focus was on my foundation, the Tim Tebow Foundation, to bring faith, hope and love to those needing a brighter day in the darkest hour of need.
quotes.author: Tim Tebow

quotes.quote: I'm moving on. I should have made that clear when I made the announcement. I guess I wasn't clear. If people think you're leaving a show after all these years, you might be retiring. So I understand where they're coming from, but I should have impressed the fact that I hope I'm just moving on right now.
quotes.author: Regis Philbin

quotes.quote: When I was in elementary school, I used to write letters to myself. I'd write letters and go 'Dear Kristen-at-16-years-old, happy birthday. I hope you're doing something.'
quotes.author: Kristin Kreuk

quotes.quote: When I go on holiday and people ask me what I do, I tell them I do some internet stuff and I've done a couple of books and I hope they just leave it at that.
quotes.author: Karl Pilkington

quotes.quote: The road that is built in hope is more pleasant to the traveler than the road built in despair, even though they both lead to the same destination.
quotes.author: Marion Zimmer Bradley,  The Fall of Atlantis

quotes.quote: I hope telling stories though 'Making a Difference' - as in my academic work and nonprofit work - will help me to live my grandmother's adage of 'Life is not about what happens to you, but about what you do with what happens to you.'
quotes.author: Chelsea Clinton

quotes.quote: There is hope and a kind of beauty in there somewhere, if you look for it.
quotes.author: H. R. Giger

quotes.quote: Shoot for the moon, even if you fail, you'll land among the stars
quotes.author: Cecelia Ahern,  P.S. I Love You

quotes.quote: If you don't like me, if you like me; both are equally cool. I send love and positive energy to all those people in their lives. I hope they find where they're meant to be.
quotes.author: Willow Smith

quotes.quote: I hope that in future Congresses there will reemerge a recognition that climate change is a reality, that our policies to meet our energy needs must also deal responsibly with environmental issues, including the damage caused by greenhouse gas emissions.
quotes.author: Jeff Bingaman

quotes.quote: Your positive action combined with positive thinking results in success.
quotes.author: Shiv Khera

quotes.quote: We never had a huge squad and we never had a great deal of choice. But in many ways that helps because you've got to make do with what you've got. You don't have too many problems about picking the team you just hope that everyone turns up on the day.
quotes.author: Jack Charlton

quotes.quote: I am saying that in Wales here we have a very clear election commitment and I hope, and I will express this view, I hope that every individual member of the Labour Party, will understand that and will strive to achieve unity so that we can deliver the yes vote in the Autumn.
quotes.author: Ron Davies

quotes.quote: Hope smiles from the threshold of the year to come, whispering, 'It will be happier.'
quotes.author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

quotes.quote: I think 'Heroes of Cosplay' will show a lot of the positive things, like how much effort it takes to make a costume. These people on the show aren't taking shortcuts. As long as that effort gets through to the viewers, we will be inspirational. Then there will be people who watch the show that want to get in and hands-on make outfits.
quotes.author: Yaya Han

quotes.quote: This suspense is terrible. I hope it will last.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: I hope the millions of people I've touched have the optimism and desire to share their goals and hard work and persevere with a positive attitude.
quotes.author: Michael Jordan

quotes.quote: 'Do What You Gotta Do' is a positive, inspirational song that says no matter what it is; whether you're up against challenges or trying to get your dreams and aspirations met, you should do what whatever you have to do shy of killing yourself or someone else.
quotes.author: Angie Stone

quotes.quote: When I die, I hope to go to Heaven, whatever the Hell that is.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand
